programme.title: Claws
programme.sub-title: Chapter Ten: Grace / Kapitel zehn: Gnade
programme.desc: Five women own their own nail salons in Florida. But the five nail carers want more variety in their lives. For this reason, they enter the male-dominated world of organized crime. / Funf Frauen besitzen ihre eigenen Nagelstudios in Florida. Doch die funf Nagelpflegerinnen wollen mehr Abwechslung in ihrem Leben. Aus diesem Grund steigen sie in die von Mannern dominierten Welt des organisierten Verbrechens ein.

programme.title: Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives as a single father with his six children. However, he spends most of his time in the bar and prefers to spend the little money the family has on alcohol instead of food. His eldest daughter Fiona is forced to take on the role of mother to her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal Lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile Debbie, the violent 10-year-old Carl and little Liam. Together, the children try to master their lives in a creative, scandalless, but also warm-hearted way, despite their impossible father. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Nils Holgersson
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Nils Holgersson annoys the animals on his parents' farm and also has other nasty fun. As a punishment, a gnome turns him into a dwarf, and the innocent hamster Krumel is not spared either. / Der vierzehnjahrige Nils Holgersson argert die Tiere auf dem elterlichen Bauernhof und treibt auch sonst uble SpaSSe. Ein Wichtelmannchen verwandelt ihn zur Strafe in einen Zwerg, und auch der unschuldige Hamster Krumel bleibt nicht verschont.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Servus Kasperl
programme.desc: Die Sendung prasentiert Malwettbewerbe, GeburtstagsgruSSe und Geschichten mit dem Kasperl.

programme.title: The miracle YOU / Das Wunder DU
programme.desc: Die Kindersendung befasst sich mit wissenschaftlichen Themen rund um den menschlichen Korper.

programme.title: Tolle Tiere
programme.desc: Kurt the cat goes on a journey through the Schonbrunn Zoo. It introduces native and exotic wild animals as well as popular and unusual pets. As zoo helpers, two children also experience working with the zoo animals up close. / Kater Kurt begibt sich auf eine Reise durch den Tiergarten Schonbrunn. Er stellt heimische und exotische Wildtiere sowie beliebte und ungewohnliche Haustiere vor. Als Zoohelfer erleben zwei Kinder zudem hautnah die Arbeit mit den Zootieren.

programme.title: Barbapapa und Familie
programme.desc: Barbapapa, Barbamama and their seven children can change objects and things with their will. Using this power, the nine go on many different fun and exciting adventures around the world. / Barbapapa, Barbamama und ihre sieben Kinder konnen Gegenstande und Dinge mit ihrem Willen verandern. Mithilfe dieser Kraft begeben sich die neun auf viele verschiedene lustige und spannende Abenteuer rund um den Erdball.

programme.title: Garfield
programme.desc: Garfield, the world's laziest cat, is back and has more fun adventures. Garfield's quirky misadventures here are generally rougher and more bizarre than in the past. / Garfield, der faulste Kater der Welt ist zuruck und erlebt noch mehr witzige Abenteuer. Dabei fallen Garfields schrullige Missgeschicke hier in der Regel derber und bizarrer aus als in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - The quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First, the topic of the searched term is announced. The candidates are supposed to get on the right track with the help of four clues - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk used to be little too / Mr. Monk war auch mal klein
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.desc: Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.title: Luzifer
programme.desc: Johannes suffers from Kaspar-Hauser syndrome - he is a grown man with the mind of a child. He lives with his strictly religious mother in a small alpine hut that is isolated from the rest of the world. However, when the small family's land is to be developed for tourism, the simple life of the two begins to change drastically. John tries to find answers in an exorcism that questions his faith. / Johannes leidet am Kaspar-Hauser-Syndrom - er ist ein erwachsener Mann mit dem Verstand eines Kindes. Mit seiner streng religiosen Mutter lebt er in einer kleinen Almhutte, die isoliert vom Rest der Welt ist. Als jedoch das Land der kleinen Familie touristisch erschlossen werden soll, beginnt sich das einfache Leben der beiden drastisch zu verandern. Johannes versucht in einem Exorzismus Antworten zu finden, der seinen Glauben in Frage stellt.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk enters the fashion world / Mr. Monk betritt die Modewelt
programme.desc: Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Live is Life - Die Spatzunder
programme.desc: The rather unsuccessful rock musician and life artist Rocco ends up in a retirement home, where he is supposed to serve a prison sentence as a social service. He soon had a heated argument with the home management and nursing staff. In particular, the resolute but definitely attractive sister Marina is not prepared to let the rascal dance around her. But he gradually realizes that it can be worthwhile to take old people seriously. / Den ziemlich erfolglosen Rockmusiker und Lebenskunstler Rocco verschlagt es in ein Seniorenheim, wo er eine Haftstrafe als sozialen Dienst abdienen soll. Schon bald gerat er mit der Heimleitung und dem Pflegepersonal heftig aneinander. Insbesondere die resolute, aber durchaus attraktive Schwester Marina ist nicht bereit, sich von dem Schlitzohr auf der Nase herumtanzen zu lassen. Dieser erkennt aber allmahlich, dass es sich durchaus lohnen kann, die alten Menschen ernst zu nehmen.

programme.desc: Red-haired bomb expert and former NYPD agent Horatio Caine is the head of the CSI division in Miami. There he and his team are responsible for the security of the city. programme.desc: Haufig sind sie gemeinsam vor Ort, ob bei Raububerfall, Brandstiftung oder hilflose Personen. Die Arbeit von Polizisten, Notarzten und Rettungssanitatern erfordert nicht nur Sachkenntnis, sondern auch Einfuhlungsvermogen und Durchsetzungskraft.

programme.title: CSI: On the trail of the perpetrators / CSI: Den Tatern auf der Spur
programme.desc: A team of Las Vegas police forensic specialists examine crime scenes and analyze evidence left by perpetrators and victims. They then use these traces to try to solve the crimes in question. / Ein Team forensischer Spezialisten der Polizei in Las Vegas untersucht Tatorte und analysiert Spuren, die von Tatern und Opfern hinterlassen wurden. Anhand dieser Spuren versuchen sie dann, die jeweiligen Verbrechen zu klaren.

programme.desc: Das Fruhmagazin um acht informiert uber die wichtigsten Meldungen des Tages und die neuesten Entwicklungen der Nacht. Neben Informationen und Einordnungen aktueller Ereignisse bietet die Sendung unterhaltsame VIP-, Magazin- sowie Servicethemen.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: The soap is set in tune with the times and in the middle of Berlin. The gripping stories about love, drama, friendship, intrigue, family, crime and current socially relevant topics that get under your skin are exciting. / Die Soap spielt am Puls der Zeit und mitten in Berlin. Spannend sind die packenden Geschichten rund um Liebe, Drama, Freundschaft, Intrigen, Familie, Crime und dazu aktuell sozial-relevante Themen, die unter die Haut gehen.

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.sub-title: One, two, police / Eins, zwei, Polizei
programme.desc: The eventful everyday life of several generations takes place in Kolner Schillerallee 10, a residential and commercial building in the Ehrenfeld district. Starting from the Weigel family's bakery and pastry shop, the stories of friendship, love, intrigue and shattered dreams begin. The focus is on the Weigel family, who run a pastry shop on the ground floor and have three generations living in the house. Different families move in and out of the house on Schillerallee, and the young residents of the attic in particular change often. / In der Kolner Schillerallee 10, einem Wohn- und Geschaftshaus im Stadtteil Ehrenfeld, findet das ereignisreiche Alltagsleben mehrerer Generationen statt. Ausgehend von der Backerei und Konditorei der Familie Weigel nehmen die Geschichten um Freundschaft, Liebe, Intrigen und geplatzte Traume ihren Lauf. Dabei steht die Familie Weigel, die eine Konditorei im Erdgeschoss betreibt und mit drei Generationen im Haus lebt, im Mittelpunkt. Unterschiedliche Familien ziehen in das Haus in der Schillerallee ein und aus, vor allem die jungen Bewohner des Dachgeschosses wechseln oft.

programme.title: Ulrich Wetzel - The criminal court / Ulrich Wetzel - Das Strafgericht
programme.sub-title: Sperrte gute Seele des Tierschutzvereins Chef in Kafig?
programme.desc: In the series, Ulrich Wetzel deals with new cases in criminal law and gives judgments on them. / In der Serie befasst sich Ulrich Wetzel mit neuen Fallen des Strafrechts und spricht dazu Urteile.

programme.title: Barbara Salesch - Das Strafgericht
programme.sub-title: Murder of a fence - Did the undercover police officer switch sides? / Mord an Hehlerin - Wechselte Undercover-Polizistin die Seiten?
programme.desc: Nach uber zehn Jahren Pause kehrt die bekannte und beliebte Fernsehjurorin Barbara Salesch zuruck in den Gerichtssaal. Dort verhandelt sie erneut fiktive Falle vor dem Hintergrund eines Strafgerichts und spricht anschlieSSend die Urteile.

programme.title: Point 12 - The RTL lunchtime journal / Punkt 12 - Das RTL-Mittagsjournal
programme.desc: Das Magazin sendet aktuelle Nachrichten zur Mittagszeit aus Koln. Die Moderatorin prasentiert Informationen mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Deutschland und spricht auSSerdem uber Servicethemen, Lifestyle sowie das Neueste aus der Welt der Stars.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Dr. Leonard Leakey Hofstadter and Dr. Sheldon Cooper are brilliant physicists, work in the same institute and share an apartment. When it comes to dealing with the social environment, Sheldon in particular has his difficulties. Her circle of friends includes Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Koothrappali and engineer Howard Wolowitz. When pretty Penny moves into the apartment next door, she initially can't do much with the strange scientists who prefer to spend their free time in the comic book store and playing Halo or World of Warcraft. After a while, she grows fond of the group. / Dr. Leonard Leakey Hofstadter und Dr. Sheldon Cooper sind geniale Physiker, arbeiten im selben Institut und teilen sich eine Wohnung. Im Umgang mit der sozialen Umwelt hingegen hat vor allem Sheldon seine Schwierigkeiten. Zu ihrem Freundeskreis gehoren Dr. Rajesh Ramayan Koothrappali und der Ingenieur Howard Wolowitz. Als die hubsche Penny in die Wohnung nebenan einzieht, kann sie zunachst nicht viel mit den merkwurdigen Wissenschaftlern, die ihre Freizeit am liebsten im Comicbuchladen und Halo oder World of Warcraft spielend verbringen, anfangen. Nach einer Weile wachst ihr die Gruppe aber ans Herz.

programme.sub-title: Life is not a pony farm / 10 with a catch / Das Leben ist kein Ponyhof / 10 mit Haken
programme.desc: In new episodes, three police duos are accompanied on their everyday missions. Pro Folge werden zwei Einsatze gezeigt, wobei die Beamten ihre Arbeit anschlieSSend kommentieren und so tiefere Einblicke in ihre Arbeit gewahren.

programme.title: Explosive - The Magazine / Explosiv - Das Magazin
programme.desc: Die Sendung beschaftigt sich mit den Hintergrunden der tagesaktuellen Ereignisse. Die Themen sind verbraucherfreundlich und gehen informativ, ehrlich und unterhaltsam auf alltagliche Probleme und haufig gestellte Fragen ein.

programme.title: Exclusive - The star magazine / Exclusiv - Das Starmagazin
programme.desc: Dieses Magazin berichtet von aktuellen Ereignissen aus der Welt der Prominenten.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell
programme.desc: Die Sendung prasentiert die aktuellen Nachrichten und zeigt Servicebeitrage zu Themen wie Finanzen, Reisen und Shopping. Zudem werfen die Moderatoren einen Blick auf die aktuellen Geschehnisse im Bereich des Sports und des Lifestyles.

programme.title: RTL Aktuell: The weather / RTL Aktuell: Das Wetter
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt eine ausfuhrliche Wettervorhersage fur Deutschland in den kommenden Tagen.

programme.title: Alles was zahlt
programme.desc: The focus is on “Steinkamp Sport and Wellness” in Essen. The sports center with ice rink and the "pumping station" next door is the focus of the series about the Steinkamp clan, with the associated intrigues and love problems. / Im Fokus steht "Steinkamp Sport and Wellness" in Essen. Das Sportzentrum mit Eishalle und dem "Pumpwerk" nebenan steht im Mittelpunkt der Serie rund um den Steinkamp-Clan, mit den dazugehorigen Intrigen und Liebesproblemen.

programme.title: Gute Zeiten, schlechte Zeiten
programme.desc: The soap is set in tune with the times and in the middle of Berlin. The gripping stories about love, drama, friendship, intrigue, family, crime and current socially relevant topics that get under your skin are exciting. / Die Soap spielt am Puls der Zeit und mitten in Berlin. Spannend sind die packenden Geschichten rund um Liebe, Drama, Freundschaft, Intrigen, Familie, Crime und dazu aktuell sozial-relevante Themen, die unter die Haut gehen.

programme.title: The Summer House of the Stars - Battle of the Celebrity Couples / Das Sommerhaus der Stars - Kampf der Promipaare
programme.desc: A diverse range of celebrity couples move into the summer house to win the title of “The Celebrity Couple”. The couples share their living space and face a wide variety of challenges. They have no idea that airy trips to the heights and wet dives as well as other exciting tasks await them. Collaboration and mutual trust are the be-all and end-all on the way to the title and the celebrities reveal completely new sides. It remains exciting because in every show a couple has to leave the house. / Bunt gemischte Promipaare ziehen in das Sommerhaus, um den Titel "Das Promipaar" zu ergattern. Die Paare teilen ihren Lebensraum und stellen sich den unterschiedlichsten Herausforderungen. Dabei ahnen sie nicht, dass sie luftige Ausfluge in die Hohe und nasse Tauchgange sowie weitere aufregende Aufgaben erwarten. Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiges Vertrauen sind das A und O auf dem Weg zum Titel und die Prominenten offenbaren ganz neue Seiten. Dabei bleibt es spannend, denn in jeder Sendung muss ein Paar das Haus verlassen.

programme.title: Extra: The RTL magazine / Extra: Das RTL-Magazin
programme.desc: Das Wochenmagazin zeigt Reportagen, Testberichte und ausfuhrliche Hintergrundberichte uber verschiedene aktuelle Themen. Die Moderatorin prasentiert gesellschaftlich relevante Themen und sorgt mit investigativen Berichten, informativen Verbrauchertipps und aufwendigen Lebensmitteltests sowie Sicherheitschecks fur Gesprachsstoff. Das Magazin ist stets am Puls der Zeit und deckt Missstande auf, die von Behorden ubersehen werden. Die Reporter gehen dabei haufig an ihre Grenzen und beweisen immer wieder Mut, Ausdauer und Geduld.

programme.title: RTL Nachtjournal
programme.desc: Late at night, the night journal shows comprehensive news of the day from Germany and the world. Viewers can keep up to date with the latest events from politics, business and culture at night. The magazine's trademark includes facts, background reporting and opinions on current global and regional issues. With the section “100 Days Later,” the program takes up headline-grabbing events from the past, shows their consequences and developments and asks about the consequences. / Das Nachtjournal zeigt zu spater Stunde noch umfassende Nachrichten des Tages aus Deutschland und der Welt. Mit den aktuellsten Ereignissen aus der Politik, Wirtschaft und Kultur konnen sich die Zuschauer nachts noch auf dem Laufenden halten. Das Markenzeichen des Magazins umfasst Fakten, Hintergrundberichterstattungen sowie Meinungen zu den aktuellen globalen sowie regionalen Themen. Mit der Rubrik "100 Tage danach" greift die Sendung schlagzeilentrachtige Ereignisse aus der Vergangenheit auf, zeigt deren Folgen und Entwicklungen und fragt nach den Konsequenzen.

programme.title: ntv Faktenzeichen
programme.desc: Die Moderatorin Julia Weber arbeitet mit einem Verifizierungsteam zusammen, um aufzuzeigen, wie leicht Menschen von realistischen Falschungen getauscht werden konnen. Dabei vermittelt sie Methoden, um Fakes zu identifizieren.

programme.title: RTL Night Journal - The Weather / RTL Nachtjournal - Das Wetter
programme.desc: Gezeigt werden ausfuhrliche Wettervorhersagen fur Deutschland in den kommenden Tagen.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Red-haired bomb expert and former NYPD agent Horatio Caine is the head of the CSI division in Miami. There he and his team are responsible for the security of the city. Using forensics, genetic engineering and forensic medicine, the CSI officers solve tricky traps. Horatio is known for his photographic memory and dry charm. At his side, the ballistician Calleigh Duquesne, the well-read Tim Speedle, DNA specialist Alexx Woods and Eric Delko, a specialist in fingerprint analysis and an expert in the drug world, are investigating. / Der rothaarige Bombenexperte und ehemalige NYPD Agent Horatio Caine ist der Leiter der CSI-Abteilung in Miami. Dort ist er gemeinsam mit seinem Team fur die Sicherheit der Stadt verantwortlich. Mittels Forensik, Gentechnik und Gerichtsmedizin losen die Beamten des CSI knifflige Falle. Horatio ist fur sein fotografisches Gedachtnis und seinen trockenen Charme bekannt. An seiner Seite ermitteln die Ballistikerin Calleigh Duquesne, der belesene Tim Speedle, DNA-Spezialistin Alexx Woods und Eric Delko, Spezialist fur die Auswertung von Fingerabdrucken sowie Experte im Drogenmillieu.

programme.title: Unter uns
programme.desc: The eventful everyday life of several generations takes place in Kolner Schillerallee 10, a residential and commercial building in the Ehrenfeld district. Starting from the Weigel family's bakery and pastry shop, the stories of friendship, love, intrigue and shattered dreams begin. The focus is on the Weigel family, who run a pastry shop on the ground floor and have three generations living in the house. Different families move in and out of the house on Schillerallee, and the young residents of the attic in particular change often. / In der Kolner Schillerallee 10, einem Wohn- und Geschaftshaus im Stadtteil Ehrenfeld, findet das ereignisreiche Alltagsleben mehrerer Generationen statt. Dabei steht die Familie Weigel, die eine Konditorei im Erdgeschoss betreibt und mit drei Generationen im Haus lebt, im Mittelpunkt. programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all this in the living room at home - the “Yoga Magazine” makes it possible. Competent and friendly yoga trainers show the best exercises for switching off. By the way, the program doesn't just report from the television studio. The programs are often recorded in a very special location - for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.desc: The Person series is a Turkish criminal drama from 2018. in the director of the Sayplace, which in magnificent way connects the true tragedy and absurdity of life, and the test of existence puts moral values. Aware that will soon forget everything, that from his personality and value will not remain nothing, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skillfully dragged himself under the hands of the law. He goes into a vengeful campaign, and the task of revealing who turns the dirtiest souls and minds of Istanbul the inspection nevers, which has been a jailer in their own living. How terrible will be the network of secrets, death of witnesses and forgets? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

The first daily information, the first morning rapports from the field throughout the Republika Srpska, interesting contributions from the world of politics, culture and sports, dedicated to people and interesting events. / Jutarnji program Alternativne televizije "ATV jutro" specifičan je spoj informative i zabave. Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies in the 1980s, located in the World War II in France occupied by German troops. In the town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Cafe Artois, a place to socialize French, and the Germans. Colonel von Strohm asks Renea to hide in his cafe stolen the image, which he wanted himself at the same time as Hitler. Rene is trying to maintain a balance in his business to satisfy French resistance and the Nazi troops and so he could survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Pogledaj u sutra
programme.desc: Chloe Delcourt went in search of her son after a terrible explosion on the shore. Her life turns upside down as her sister's body found on the coast, whom she has not seen for years ... / Chloe Delcourt otišla je u potragu za svojim sinom nakon strašne eksplozije na obali Sète. Njezin život okrene se naglavačke kada na obali pronađu tijelo njezine sestre koju godinama nije vidjela...

programme.title: ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most viewed alternative television show _ central news exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news brings an overview of events in the Republika Srpska, BiH, region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on the current topics of the day. Journalists The ATV news editorial is investigated, reveal and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city curriculum, sports and time. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Exercise with Lydia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world we often don't have time to exercise. Many are the benefits of regular exercise. In addition to body shaping, you are also provided with good health. In addition to good physical form, exercise contributes to good mental health. By exercising, endorphins relax, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positive. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Boks
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Martial arts - mma / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 320 / MMA UFC 320
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 318 / MMA UFC 318
programme.desc: The term "Mixed Martial Arts" was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing a review of the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football Qualifying for SP 2026 / Fudbal Kvalifikacije za SP 2026
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Fudbal - Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Through the long history of football football, the national team always had a special charm with players and fans, whether it was official or friendly matches. International friendly football matches are a great opportunity for menus and federations to take advantage of free representative terms without official teams to gather the teams and play different tactical ideas. In recent years, the practice has been playing such meetings on neutral ground so that fans from different sides of the world have the opportunity to watch the best teams and individuals. / Kroz dugu historiju nogometa utakmice reprezentacija uvijek su imale posebnu draž kod igrača i navijača, bilo da se radilo o službenim ili prijateljskim utakmicama. Međunarodne prijateljske nogometne utakmice odlična su prilika izbornicima i savezima za iskoristiti slobodne reprezentativne termine bez službenih utakmica za okupljanje momčadi te uigravanje različitih taktičkih zamisli. Posljednjih godina praksa je odigravanje takvih susreta na neutralnom terenu kako bi navijači s različitih strana svijeta imali priliku gledati najbolje momčadi i pojedince.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Handball - Ehf European League / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: EHF Cup How else by importance, competition for male handball clubs in Europe begins in 1993. years. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup that did its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012. The EHF Cup was connected by a former EHF Cup Cup Cup Cup. The competition as well as the Champions League consists of part where clubs play by groups and the best passes into the "Knock Out" phase. After the quarterfinals in two matches between the opponent, Sylad "Final Four". Semifinals and finals, as well as a match for a third place, are played on a single match. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu.

These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Fudbal - Prijateljska utakmica
programme.desc: Through the long history of football football, the national team always had a special charm with players and fans, whether it was official or friendly matches. International friendly football matches are a great opportunity for menus and federations to take advantage of free representative terms without official teams to gather the teams and play different tactical ideas. In recent years, the practice has been playing such meetings on neutral ground so that fans from different sides of the world have the opportunity to watch the best teams and individuals. / Kroz dugu historiju nogometa utakmice reprezentacija uvijek su imale posebnu draž kod igrača i navijača, bilo da se radilo o službenim ili prijateljskim utakmicama. Međunarodne prijateljske nogometne utakmice odlična su prilika izbornicima i savezima za iskoristiti slobodne reprezentativne termine bez službenih utakmica za okupljanje momčadi te uigravanje različitih taktičkih zamisli. Posljednjih godina praksa je odigravanje takvih susreta na neutralnom terenu kako bi navijači s različitih strana svijeta imali priliku gledati najbolje momčadi i pojedince.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (F) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (F) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (F) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (F) 2026 / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž) 2026
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - 2. ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: 2. The ABA league is the second degree of the regional basketball ABA league. Krka New place is the historical first winner of the ABA 2. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: (No) the success of the champion / (Ne)uspjeh prvaka

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The aim of this league to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the final tournament of the best four or popularly called Final for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje.
