programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Leagues, competitions founded in the 2017/2018 season. With a victory on the Fajnal Forum and a goblet intended for the winner, the Krka team achieved a placement in 1. ABA league from the next season. The league participates 12 teams that seek the road to four best teams and placement on Fainal for. Purpose of the ABA 2. The league is to enable smaller basketball environments competition with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Handball: EHF Champions League / Rukomet: EHF Liga prvaka
programme.desc: Handball league Championships has since 1955. when the competition was founded under the name Cup Champions. We received the first winner in the 1956-1957 season. years, and that was the threshold team because only city selections were performed at that season. Today, that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993. The competition was held under that name and played according to the Cup system on the relegation. Since 1993. In addition to changing the name in the Champions League, the group phase of the competition was introduced after which the following are elimination. The group phase changed with age and is also introduced and FAINAL FOR FOR FOUR FOUR FROM EUROPE HANDMETICS AFTER that the champion was obtained. / Rukometna Liga prvaka svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobjednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu prvaka, uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama mijenjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (W) / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž)
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Hockey to LED - league of the first / Hokej na ledu - Liga prvaka

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: NHL
programme.desc: "NATONAL HOCKEY LEAGUE" is the most prestigious club hockey competition that dates back to 1917. when the competition was formed and functioned with two more North American hockey stars. programme.title: Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Handball - Qualifications for EP (W) / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž)
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest Female Continental Handball Competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants in this competition, considering that the host has a secured direct placement to the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualification phase consists of two groups in which the group's winner goes to another phase. In the second and final phase of qualifications there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants. From each group to the European Championship, two first-placed teams will be placed and one best ranked, third of all groups. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će donijeti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dvije faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dvije grupe u kojoj pobjednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podijeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dvije prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Plodovi zemlje
programme.desc: Sunday's Agriculture and Fisheries' show deals with current topics, talks critically about agrarian politics, advises and teaches viewers and brings agroprognosis. The oldest specialized show of Croatian Television has been aired since 1958. / Nedjeljna emisija o poljoprivredi i ribarstvu bavi se aktualnim temama, kritički progovara o agrarnoj politici, savjetuje i poučava gledatelje te donosi agroprognozu. Najstarija specijalizirana emisija Hrvatske televizije, emitira se od 1958. godine.

programme.title: Nedjeljom u dva
programme.desc: The guest of the show on Sundays at 2 is Dusko Ilijevic, "Stricek Dusko", a educator at a kindergarten in Zagreb. Based on the 20-year experience of working with children, they will explain why she thinks today's parents are too indulgent and how to set the boundaries in their daily lives for children. Empathy, climbing the trees, jumping on the mud and using a cell phone are some of the topics of the show that talks about raising children. / Gost emisije Nedjeljom u 2 je Duško Ilijević, "striček Duško", odgajatelj u jednom zagrebačkom dječjem vrtiću. Na temelju 20-godišnjeg iskustva rada s djecom objasnit će zašto misli da su današnji roditelji previše popustljivi i kako djeci postaviti granice u svakodnevnom životu. Empatija, penjanje po drveću, skakanje po blatu i upotreba mobitela neke su od tema emisije u kojoj se govori o odgoju djece.

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Vijesti iz kulture
programme.desc: Culture news is followed daily events from different areas of culture and art. / Vijesti iz kulture svakodnevno prate događaje iz različitih područja kulture i umjetnosti.

programme.title: Skica za portret
programme.desc: In the form of a short documentary film, the show represents the authors important for Croatian history and culture. / U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu.

programme.title: Pozitivno
programme.desc: Find out where it is and how the sanctuary of the Mother of God of Jerusalem was created. The artifacts, documents and books written in Glagolitic script are located in 27 countries and 90 cities. The president of the Glagolitic Friends Society Darko Žubrinić tells us about several less known interesting things related to Glagolitic. Take a peek with us in the oldest church in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Doznajte gdje se nalazi i kako je nastalo svetište Majke Božje Jeruzalemske. Artefakti, dokumenti i knjige pisane glagoljicom nalaze se u 27 zemalja i 90 gradova. Predsjednik Društva prijatelja glagoljice Darko Žubrinić govori nam o nekoliko manje poznatih zanimljivosti vezanih za glagoljicu. Zavirite s nama u najstariju crkvu u Bosni i Hercegovini.

programme.title: Also: More / Pula: More
programme.desc: A mosaic informative issue dedicated to the richness of our Adriatic Sea, Coast and Coast. It brings interesting reports on topics related to living at sea and with it. It is broadcast from HRT studies Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Pula. / Mozaična informativna emisija posvećena bogatstvu našeg Jadranskog mora, obale i priobalja. Donosi zanimljive reportaže o temama vezanim za život na moru i uz njega. Emitira se iz HRT-ovih studija Split, Rijeka, Zadar i Pula.

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

programme.title: Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: This sequel is Ricotte. Lidia will prepare simple with grandson Miles, and the delicious Bruscheta of a maximum of three ingredients. We will then see a version of a classic roast pasta dish, which everyone loves _ pancakes stuffed with spinach and ricott. The dessert will be cookies with ricott and chocolate pieces, a favorite in Lydia's family. Join Lydia and learn how versatile Ricotta is. / Ovaj je nastavak u znaku ricotte. Lidia će s unukom Milesom pripremiti jednostavne, a slasne bruskete od najviše tri sastojka. Potom ćemo vidjeti inačicu klasičnog jela od pečene tjestenine, koje svi vole _ palačinke nadjevene špinatom i ricottom. Desert će biti kolačići s ricottom i komadićima čokolade, omiljeni u Lidijinoj obitelji. Pridružite se Lidiji i naučite koliko je ricotta svestrana.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Children are the most vulnerable participants in traffic. They travel to school every day, for training, play on the streets and sidewalks, and their safety is largely in our hands. How much do we teach them traffic rules, how many are adults responsible, what can we do to make their way safe? / Djeca su najranjiviji sudionici u prometu. Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. Koliko ih učimo prometnim pravilima, koliko smo mi odrasli odgovorni, što možemo učiniti da im put bude siguran?

programme.title: Cacau
programme.desc: Marco tries to justify his threats to Tiago, claiming it is because of the love of Cacau. Rui thinks the Baron of a cheater who wanted to deceive Simone. Cacau decides to give up shared custody of the child, stating that Marco does not deserve to have contacts with their son. Valdemar persuades Susana to work for him. / Marco pokušava opravdati svoje prijetnje Tiagu tvrdeći da je to zbog ljubavi prema Cacau. Rui misli da je barun varalica koji je htio prevariti Simone. Cacau se odluči odreći zajedničkog skrbništva nad djetetom, navodeći da Marco ne zaslužuje imati kontakte s njihovim sinom. Valdemar nagovori Susanu da radi za njega.

programme.title: La Promesa
programme.desc: Jana tells Píja that the blood on the rug could be Tomás. Cruz warned ángelo not pushing her nose into what she was not concerned. Manuel tells her father that he wants to leave La Provece. Santos threatens Píji _ He knows she killed Baron de Linai. / Jana kaže Píji da bi krv na sagu mogla biti Tomásova. Cruz upozori Ángelu da ne gura nos u ono što je se ne tiče. Manuel kaže ocu da želi otići s La Promesa. Santos zaprijeti Píji _ on zna da je ubila baruna De Linaju.

programme.title: Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: The herb hunter visits the "Croatian Sahara", which is made up of the remains of the only Croatian desert and the geographical-Botanical reserve. The desert is located on the eastern part of the town of Đurđevac. Đurđevac Sands represent a variety of habitats for the entire living settlement. Some of the plants in this episode are gray thunder, silk, chin chin, early hamster, rabbit and medicinal asparagus. The guests of the episode are B.Sc. Geology Martin Mahović and Željka Kolar from the Public Institution for the Management of Protected Nature Parts in the Koprivnica-Križevci County. / Lovac na bilje posjećuje "Hrvatsku Saharu" koju čine ostaci jedine hrvatske pustinje i geografsko-botanički rezervat. Pustinja se nalazi na istočnom dijelu Grada Đurđevca. Đurđevački pijesci predstavljaju raznolika staništa za cijelo živo naselje. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su siva gromotulja, svilenica, vlasulja bradica, rani hrčak, zečjak i ljekovita šparoga. Gosti epizode su dipl. ing. geologije Martin Mahović i Željka Kolar iz Javne ustanove za upravljanje zaštićenim dijelovima prirode na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije.

programme.title: Flowers Sasha Sekovje / Cvijeće Saše Šekoranje
programme.desc: Our famous artist and arranger Sasa Šekoranja shows us how we can make our own floral magic at home. / Naš poznati umjetnik i aranžer Saša Šekoranja pokazuje nam kako kod kuće možemo napraviti vlastitu cvjetnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: The Ben Fogle adventurer will spend the week in the Portuguese Highlands with Alex, 39, a British who once dealt with the sale of outdoor stay equipment and today live on the slope of the mountain. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. / Pustolov Ben Fogle provest će tjedan u portugalskom gorju s Alexom (39), Britancem koji se nekoć bavio prodajom opreme za boravak na otvorenom, a danas samotno živi na obronku planine. Psihička kriza i osobna tragedija prisilile su ga da preispita život i odseli se iz Britanije. Ben će saznati kako je Alex svojedobno preživio bez grijanja, struje i vode. Danas preuređuje stoljetne građevine u idealan seoski dom. Ispričat će Benu s kakvim se izazovima suočava živeći u najtoplijem dijelu Portugala i kako je, premda uživa u samotnjačkom životu, spreman ponovno se družiti s istomišljenicima. Među istomišljenicima je i prijateljica koja mu pomaže ostvariti plan da farmu otvori za goste. I ona ima iznimnu životnu priču.

programme.title: With our home / Kod nas doma
programme.desc: Our guest is the great actress Ksenija Prohaska, with whom we talk about her new play and unforgettable roles that marked her career. programme.title: Labirint
programme.desc: In the heart of the post -war Yugoslavia, Industrogradnja, a company that changed cities and lives, was born. Skyscrapers, hotels, monumental bridges, housing _ _ It all built it. And it was built in Germany, Poland, Iraq, Russia ... Moscow adorns the impressive Russian Academy of Sciences, which is their hands. In the show "Legend of Industrogradnja" we discover stories behind concrete and steel, we explore who created and who destroyed Industrogradnja. How did the construction giant who once counted 12,500 employees disappeared? / U srcu poslijeratne Jugoslavije rodila se Industrogradnja, firma koja je mijenjala gradove i živote. Neboderi, hoteli, monumentalni mostovi, stambeni objekti _ sve je to ona gradila. A gradilo se u Njemačkoj, Poljskoj, Iraku, Rusiji... Moskvu krasi impresivna Ruska akademija znanosti koja je njihovih ruku djelo. U emisiji "Legenda o Industrogradnji" otkrivamo priče iza betona i čelika, istražujemo tko je stvarao, a tko rušio Industrogradnju. Kako je nestao građevinski div koji je nekad brojao 12.500 zaposlenih?

programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative pottery is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu's must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents _ and to some it does not fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. / Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja _ a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja.

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners _ Just on the International Day of the Elderly, October 1. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes _ by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. It will be the president of the Croatian Pensioners' Union on Monday about all this and the way of 6 euros per year of the year _ in the show on Monday on Monday, and State Secretary of State Marinko Luikned will be given. / Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike _ upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine _ pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome _ i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža _ u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda.

programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: Children are the most vulnerable participants in traffic. They travel to school every day, for training, play on the streets and sidewalks, and their safety is largely in our hands. How much do we teach them traffic rules, how many are adults responsible, what can we do to make their way safe? / Djeca su najranjiviji sudionici u prometu. Svakodnevno putuju u školu, na treninge, igraju se na ulicama i pločnicima, a njihova sigurnost u velikoj je mjeri u našim rukama. Koliko ih učimo prometnim pravilima, koliko smo mi odrasli odgovorni, što možemo učiniti da im put bude siguran?

programme.title: Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Our first guest, Nikola Vukosic, was born in Slunj, but his life brought him to Sibenik, where he became one of the key people of the defense of Kresimir's city. The celebrated war chief of the Šibenik Police Directorate was celebrated, and the pension was greeted by acquiring the highest police vocation _ main inspector. Along with him is Zirjanin Goran Grguricin, then the Assistant Chief of the Šibenik Police Department. Nicholas and he together worked on the reorganization of police from a peacetime to war and directly managed to all combat activities. Grguricin is also a master of legal sciences, from the field of criminal sciences. / Naš prvi gost, Nikola Vukošić, rođen je u Slunju, no život ga je doveo u Šibenik, gdje je postao jedan od ključnih ljudi obrane Krešimirova grada. Proslavljeni je ratni načelnik Policijske uprave Šibenik, a mirovinu je dočekao stekavši najviše policijsko zvanje _ glavni inspektor. programme.desc: On Dugi Island, the Žamer family shows how it is possible to make a living from agriculture and in island conditions. In addition to the production of cheese, vegetables and eggs, the family runs Robinson tourism on the islet of Krkknat. The episode also brings the story of Goran Morovic, the owner of a luxury hotel on Dugi Otok, who brings in a new dimension of tourism into an island life. / Na Dugom otoku obitelj Žampera pokazuje kako je moguće živjeti od poljoprivrede i u otočnim uvjetima. Njihove koze, kokoši i svinje su izvor hrane i ponosa, jer biti pastir na otoku znači čuvati tradiciju i identitet. Osim proizvodnje sira, povrća i jaja, obitelj vodi robinzonski turizam na otočiću Krknata. Epizoda donosi i priču Gorana Morovića, vlasnika luksuznog hotela na Dugom otoku koji unosi novu dimenziju turizma u otočki život.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle goes to Emerald Island this time. He will visit George and Bettin, an Austrian-German married couple who has been living in the Ireland wilderness for 40 years. He would tell him what they led them to leave their life in Europe so far, as they found a new life and discovered beauty in the middle of a peat. They turned a piece of land into their corner of paradise, built a house and deeply connected with the nature that surrounds them. Ben will help them tear down the dried trees, they will catch up with the neglected drainage bright and bathe in a cold stream. He is aware that George and Bettini will be increasingly difficult to maintain possession over time. / Ben Fogle ovaj put ide na Smaragdni Otok. Ispričat će mu što ih je navelo da ostave dotadašnji život u Europi, kako su našli novi život i otkrili ljepotu usred tresetišta. Pusti komad zemlje pretvorili su u svoj kutak raja, izgradili kuću i duboko se povezali s prirodom koja ih okružuje. programme.desc: A body of an unknown man was found in the Botanical Garden of the National Museum of BiH. It is still not clear whether it is an accident or murder. At the same time, Sarajevo faces the return of Senci, who, after a long prison sentence, reveals that the city is no longer the same. / U botaničkom vrtu Zemaljskog muzeja BiH pronađeno je tijelo nepoznatog muškarca. Očevid vode viši inspektor Edib Pašić i njegov partner Mido Zec, dok novinarka Ajla Pašić slučajno postaje svjedok početka istrage. Još uvijek nije jasno radi li se o nesreći ili ubojstvu. U isto vrijeme, Sarajevo se suočava s povratkom Senčija, koji nakon dugogodišnje zatvorske kazne otkriva da grad više nije isti.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Talking for a reason is longtime correspondent Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk to him about why he is so captivated by the past and the way we handle it. How much was his interest in the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is the correct claim that Germany was to blame for the process? What were the relations of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tudjman? What do the documents he explored about the relationship between Croatian politics to BiH at the time are revealed? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ There are many reasons to talk to Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: The journey of Ethiopia Christian Ilicic begins in Harara, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of people and hyenas, and so does Christian meet the pack of wild hiens who are pouring the city at night by feeding on waste. Visiting Gondar, the former headquarters of Ethiopian rulers, Christian finds himself in the Zone of the Conflict of the Army and the Rebel. Despite the danger of war, he climbs the Semien Mountain to find the monkeys of Gelada, a unique kind of primat that lives only in that location. Briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so -called eighth world miracle _ in a rock carved church of St. Juraj. Arriving in the modern metropolis addis Abeb, Christian explores the past and present of the big city _ hanging out with Rap Star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Meneka, in which 125 years ago, the Seljan brothers stayed. / Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom _ u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada _ druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan.

programme.title: Krah
programme.desc: The investigation continues, and shocking truths come to the surface. Two years ago, while celebrating Andrew's 50th birthday, Jess Liz acknowledged the dark secret. In the present, Liz is crucified between Jess, Ed and Social Service. Liz and Ed try to reach Jess, but I can't fight her anger and pain. Jess is getting harder to cope with a situation she can't control. Friends slowly realize that Ed has the other side. Everyone is surprised by his behavior towards family and friends at a children's football tournament. After friends are getting deeper into Carrisford's family problems, rumors begin to spread. Mel moved into their home and discovered that everything was not as perfect as it seemed. Charlotte take a drastic step to support EDA, revealing new secrets about what actually happened on Friday. Detective Rustin and Lucy Harding put a family under pressure and seek cracks in marriage that once seemed perfect. A visit under the supervision of a social service is converted to chaos, and new facts around the health status are revealed. / Istraga se nastavlja, a na površinu izlaze šokantne istine. Prije dvije godine, za vrijeme proslave Andrewova 50. rođendana, pijana je Jess Liz priznala mračnu tajnu. U sadašnjosti, Liz je razapeta između Jess, Eda i socijalne službe. Liz i Ed pokušavaju doprijeti do Jess, no ne mogu se boriti protiv njezina bijesa i boli. Jess se sve teže nosi sa situacijom koju ne može kontrolirati. Prijatelji polako shvaćaju da Ed ima i drugu stranu. Svi su iznenađeni njegovim ponašanjem prema obitelji i prijateljima na dječjem nogometom turniru. Nakon što se prijatelji sve dublje počinju uplitati u obiteljske probleme Carrisforda, glasine se počinju širiti. Mel se useli u njihov dom i otkrije da sve nije savršeno kao što se činilo. Charlotte napravi drastičan korak kako bi poduprla Eda, pri čemu se otkriju nove tajne o tome što se zapravo dogodilo u petak. Detektiv Rustin i Lucy Harding stavljaju obitelj pod pritisak i traže pukotine u braku koji se nekoć činio savršenim. Posjet pod nadzorom socijalne službe pretvara se u kaos, a otkrivaju se i nove činjenice oko zdravstvenog stanja.

programme.title: Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: In this episode of Fiona Bruce and Philip Mold, they go to France in search of two greats of impressionism and post -impressionism _ Camille Pisarr and his friend and protégé, Paul Cezanne. Fiona travels through the amazing Provencal landscape exploring a simple watercolor owned by Dominique Rogers. She is Pranac's Anthony Valabrègue, a poet, art critic and Cezanne's close friend, who he has repeatedly served as a model. Dominique, who is not a special girlfriend of Cezanne's painting style, believes that it is the gift of Cezanne himself, who handed Valabrègue's widow to her father in the 1920s. Fiona visits Cezanne's studio in Aix-En-Provence, where he lived, visits nearby quarry, at the foot of Sainte-Victoire Mountain, where rich yellowish rocks and slender trees have a strong influence on the artist's work. Is this exactly where Dominique's tree is painted? / U ovoj epizodi Fiona Bruce i Philip Mould odlaze u Francusku u potrazi za dvojicom velikana impresionizma i postimpresionizma _ Camilleom Pissarrom i njegovim prijateljem i štićenikom, Paulom Cezanneom. Fiona putuje kroz zadivljujući provansalski krajolik istražujući jednostavan akvarel u vlasništvu Dominique Rogers. Ona je pranećakinja Anthonyja Valabrèguea, pjesnika, likovnog kritičara i Cezanneova bliskog prijatelja, kojemu je više puta poslužio kao model. Dominique, koja nije osobita poklonica Cezanneova slikarskog stila, vjeruje da je riječ o daru samog Cezannea, koji je Valabrègueova udovica predala njezinu ocu dvadesetih godina. Fiona posjećuje Cezanneov atelje u Aix-en-Provenceu, gdje je živio, obilazi obližnje kamenolome, podno planine Sainte-Victoire, gdje su bogate žućkaste stijene i vitka stabla snažno utjecali na umjetnikov rad. Je li upravo tu naslikano Dominiqueino stablo?

programme.title: Katastrofa podmornice Titan
programme.desc: In June 2023. The oceangate submarine was in the last mission of descending to the Titanic wreck when it imploded at a depth of 3800 meters. All five passengers were killed in the accident. With exclusive conversations with members of the US Coast Guard Research Committee and the first published video, we discover why the tragedy happened and whether it could be prevented. We will see the analysis of the events that have led to the fatal day _ from the founding of Oceangate under the guidance of Stockton Rusha Executive, to the beginning of the construction of Titan, a unique submarine from carbon fiber, designed to lead tourists to the adventure of life _ Visit the Titanic wreck. The documentary brings a detailed account of the last mission to end with tragic implosion and launch a debate on the establishment of necessary security protocols in similar missions of deep sea research. The world traveler and researcher Josh Gates will show us his recordings of the interior of Titan for the first time, which he intended to use in the "Expedition to the Unknown" series on Discovery Channel. They were created in 2021. _ Just a few months before the submarine began to go to the missions to the Titanic wreck. An upsetting interview with Rush and a troubled test dived to Gates to cancel the recording of the planned episode. Through conversations with deep -sea technicians and researchers who participated in a submarine test, as well as longtime friends and colleagues Stockton Rush, we will learn more about insufficient safety measures and clear signs that the submarine is not sure _ but the responsible ones decided to ignore it. / U lipnju 2023. podmornica OceanGate bila je u posljednjoj misiji spuštanja na olupinu Titanica kada je implodirala na dubini od 3800 metara. U nesreći je poginulo svih pet putnika. Uz ekskluzivne razgovore s članovima istraživačkog odbora američke obalne straže i prvi put objavljene video snimke, otkrivamo zašto se tragedija dogodila te je li se mogla spriječiti. Vidjet ćemo analizu događaja koji su doveli do kobnog dana _ od osnivanja tvrtke OceanGate pod vodstvom izvršnog direktora Stocktona Rusha do početka gradnje Titana, jedinstvene podmornice od ugljičnih vlakana, projektirane kako bi vodila turiste u pustolovinu života _ posjet olupini Titanica. Dokumentarac donosi detaljni prikaz posljednje misije koja je završila tragičnom implozijom te pokreće raspravu o uspostavi nužnih sigurnosnih protokola u sličnim misijama istraživanja dubokog mora. Svjetski putnik i istraživač Josh Gates prvi put će nam pokazati svoje snimke unutrašnjosti Titana, koje je namjeravao upotrijebiti u seriji "Ekspedicija u nepoznato" na Discovery Channelu. Nastale su 2021. _ samo nekoliko mjeseci prije nego što je podmornica počela ići u misije na olupinu Titanica. Uznemirujući intervju s Rushom i problematičan testni zaron naveli su Gatesa da otkaže snimanje planirane epizode. programme.title: Dr. Beck
programme.desc: The first thought when mentioning breast health is breast cancer as a serious malignant disease that is a serious public health problem in Croatia because of a large number of patients. No, u ovoj ćemo se emisiji, uz intervencijskog radiologa, kirurga i epidemiologinju, baviti i drugim dijagnozama i stanjima dojke, koja nisu uvijek maligna, ali ih je potrebno na vrijeme otkriti i liječiti. Također ćemo naglasiti i važnost preventivnih pregleda, posebice važnih radi ranog otkrivanja i uspješnijeg liječenja bolesti dojke.

programme.title: Najljepša europska sela
programme.desc: UNESCO Heritage, a unique national park, an unreal blend of steep cliffs, natural terraces and colorful houses _ All this describes Cinque Terre, five lovely Italian villages on the Ligurian coast. With Lika police officer Tom, we explore the vibrant manarol and Riomaggiore to find the culprit for importing three million tourists and exports to a billion self -a year. We examine what it is like to cultivate vineyards that defy gravity and why houses look like the fruit of a playful baby imagination. Watch on Color TV, only on HTV. / Unescova baština, jedinstveni nacionalni park, nestvarni spoj strmih litica, prirodnih terasa i šarenih kućica _ sve to opisuje Cinque Terre, pet ljupkih talijanskih sela na ligurskoj obali. S ličkim policajcem Tomom istražujemo živopisnu Manarolu i Riomaggiore kako bismo pronašli krivca za uvoz tri milijuna turista i izvoz milijardu selfija godišnje. Ispitujemo kako je obrađivati vinograde koji prkose gravitaciji i zašto kuće izgledaju kao plod razigrane dječje mašte. Gledati na kolor televizoru, samo na HTV-u.

programme.title: Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: The journey of Ethiopia Christian Ilicic begins in Harara, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of people and hyenas, and so does Christian meet the pack of wild hiens who are pouring the city at night by feeding on waste. Visiting Gondar, the former headquarters of Ethiopian rulers, Christian finds himself in the Zone of the Conflict of the Army and the Rebel. Despite the danger of war, he climbs the Semien Mountain to find the monkeys of Gelada, a unique kind of primat that lives only in that location. Briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so -called eighth world miracle _ in a rock carved church of St. Juraj. Arriving in the modern metropolis addis Abeb, Christian explores the past and present of the big city _ hanging out with Rap Star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Meneka, in which 125 years ago, the Seljan brothers stayed. / Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom _ u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada _ druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben came to the Cornwall rock cliffs, where Todd and Davina live with the children. They left the town to the village without any experience _ guided only by a great desire to become farmers. Ben will find out that it took them five years to rearrange the estate of three hectares into a farm. They will join them in the care of different animals _ pigs, ducks and more than a hundred chickens. From first hand they will feel what their chaotic daily rhythm looks like. You need to find time for children, take care of animals, dig a pond, pick vegetables ... A good life is not always easy, especially if you are at the grace of tumultuous weather conditions on the west coast. But Bena will be most impressed by the personal challenges they face _ financially, physically and mentally. / Ben je došao na kamenite litice Cornwalla, gdje Todd i Davina žive s djecom. Otišli su iz grada na selo bez ikakvog iskustva _ vođeni samo velikom željom da postanu farmeri. Ben će saznati da im je trebalo pet godina kako bi posjed površine tri hektara preuredili u farmu. Pridružit će im se u brizi o različitim životinjama _ svinjama, patkama i više od sto kokoši. Iz prve će ruke osjetiti kako izgleda njihov kaotični dnevni ritam. Treba naći vremena za djecu, brinuti se za životinje, iskopati ribnjak, ubrati povrće... Dobar život nije uvijek lak, pogotovo ako ste na milosti burnih vremenskih uvjeta na zapadnoj obali. Ali Bena će se najviše dojmiti osobni izazovi s kojima se suočavaju _ financijski, fizički i psihički.

U Milijunašu opće znanje stapaju se s ljudskom prirodom _ koncentracijom, strategijom i mentalnom snagom pojedinca. Svako pitanje podiže ulog, a granice se pomiču iz odgovora u odgovor. Hoće li uspjeti doći do samog kraja i spremno reći: "To je moj konačni odgovor!"?

programme.title: Jamie Oliver and Dyslexia: In the fight for change / Jamie Oliver i disleksija: U borbi za promjene
programme.desc: For Jamie Oliver, participation in campaigns is nothing new, but this one is more personal than others. As one of the most famous dyslexians in the UK, Oliver is dealing with problems that children with dyslexia are constantly encountered. It is believed that 10 to 15% of people are dyslexic and about 25% is neurilities, which means that a quarter of each class is struggling with a education system that has not been adapted to them. Since science allows us to learn more about different ways of learning, Jamie wonders why to expect everyone to fit into the same old -fashioned model of education and evaluation, which was designed more than 150 years ago. This struggle brings the Government to the threshold. At the beginning of the Jamie campaign, Jamie talks to teachers, charity organizations, parents and children, who want and need government intervention. Of the hundred children at least 10 to 15, there are dyslexia, but only two are diagnosed at school, which means that at least 80% is undergoing entire education without diagnosis. A timely diagnosis can change their lives because without it it is more likely to have difficulty with confidence, self -esteem and anxiety that can remain in life. As the father of five children, Jamie knows that teachers do their jobs great and that they are not the ones, but the system. Although a quarter of classes in the UK is a neuro -difference, in a typical three -year program for new teachers, only half a day is devoted to children with learning differences, and teachers who are already in teaching do not have many training opportunities unless the schools do not finance it themselves. With the increase in awareness of special educational needs and with increasing minor budgets, our schools need help, and grant teachers in order to deal with all students equally and get the opportunity to equalize the conditions. Jamie is seeking help from his companions on social networks to bring the campaign to the Government and is overwhelmed by painful stories from all over the United Kingdom: children, parents, adults, teachers, all have been betrayed and strongly want to do more. Something has to change, and urgently. Jamie reveals that there are two key solutions that support teachers, which will bring a major change. Bridget Phillipson, State Secretary for Education in the United Kingdom, is referred to his two key requirements: 1. An early assessment is crucial, within the first two years of school. How to help children if we don't know they need support? 2. Support teachers. Teachers are amazing people and of course they want to help every child, so let them allow them to prepare and receive support for this. / Za Jamieja Olivera sudjelovanje u kampanjama nije ništa novo, ali ova je osobnija nego druge. Kao jedan od najpoznatijih disleksičara u Velikoj Britaniji, Oliver se bavi problemima s kojima se djeca s disleksijom stalno susreću. Vjeruje se da je 10 do 15% ljudi disleksično, a oko 25% je neuroraznoliko, što znači da se četvrtina svakog razreda bori s obrazovnim sustavom koji im nije prilagođen. Budući da nam znanost omogućuje da saznamo više o različitim načinima učenja, Jamie se pita zašto očekivati da se svi uklope u isti starinski model obrazovanja i ocjenjivanja koji je osmišljen prije više od 150 godina. Tu borbu dovodi Vladi na prag. Na početku kampanje Jamie razgovara s nastavnicima, dobrotvornim organizacijama, roditeljima i djecom, koji žele i trebaju Vladinu intervenciju. Od stotinu djece njih barem 10 do 15 ima disleksiju, ali je samo dvoje dijagnosticirano u školi, što znači da barem 80% prođe cijelo školovanje bez dijagnoze. Pravodobna dijagnoza može promijeniti život jer bez nje je veća vjerojatnost da će imati poteškoće sa samopouzdanjem, samopoštovanjem i tjeskobom koja im može ostati doživotno. Kao otac petero djece Jamie zna da nastavnici sjajno rade svoj posao i da krivi nisu oni, nego sustav. Iako je četvrtina razreda u Velikoj Britaniji neuroraznolika, kod tipičnog trogodišnjeg programa za nove učitelje samo se pola dana posvećuje djeci s razlikama u učenju, a učitelji koji su već u nastavi nemaju mnogo mogućnosti za osposobljavanje osim ako to škole ne financiraju same. S porastom svijesti o posebnim obrazovnim potrebama i sa sve manjim proračunima, našim školama potrebna je pomoć, a nastavnicima potpora kako bi se bavili svim učenicima podjednako i dobili priliku za izjednačenje uvjeta. Jamie traži pomoć od svojih pratitelja na društvenim mrežama kako bi kampanju doveo pred Vladu i preplavljen je bolnim pričama iz cijelog Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva: djeca, roditelji, odrasli, nastavnici, svi su iznevjereni i silno žele učiniti više. Nešto se mora promijeniti, i to hitno. Jamie otkriva da postoje dva ključna rješenja koja podržavaju i nastavnici, a koja će donijeti veliku promjenu. Svoja dva ključna zahtjeva upućuje Bridget Phillipson, državnoj tajnici za obrazovanje u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu: 1. Pravodobno primjećivanje znakova. Presudna je rana procjena, unutar prve dvije godine škole. Kako pomoći djeci ako ne znamo da im treba potpora? 2. Potpora nastavnicima. Nastavnici su nevjerojatni ljudi i naravno da žele pomoći svakom djetetu, stoga im omogućimo da se pripreme i dobiju potporu za to.

programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Thirty years, architect John and office administrator Julia are planning to build a fantastic house designed by John. They are tormented by evil happiness _ recession, losing their jobs and surpassing offers for the parcels have stopped their dream of a standalone construction. They finally secured a plot in the hill in Oxfordshire and more than ever wanting to build their home! Architect John designed the beautiful modernist part of the home to withdraw: it is elegant, it is a hiding place of life trials. But as soon as they start construction, their unhappy string continues. Coronavirus closure stops construction and every month spent in their expensive housed house is eroded by their limited budget and therefore threatens their plans for a leisurely pension. Pressure further harms John's health. However, with limited means, there is no choice but to run the project of this complex construction. / Trideset godina arhitekt John i uredska administratorica Julia planiraju izgraditi fantastičnu kuću koju je dizajnirao John. Muči ih zla sreća _ recesija, gubitak posla i nadmašivanje ponuda za parcele stali su na put njihovu snu o samostalnoj gradnji. Napokon su osigurali parcelu u Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu i više nego ikad žele izgraditi svoj dom! Arhitekt John dizajnirao je prekrasan modernistički dio doma u koji će se povući: elegantno je to skrovište od životnih kušnji. No čim počnu s gradnjom, njihov nesretni niz se nastavlja. Zatvaranje zbog koronavirusa zaustavlja gradnju i svaki mjesec proveden u njihovoj skupoj unajmljenoj kući nagriza njihov ograničeni budžet te stoga ugrožava njihove planove za lagodnu mirovinu. programme.title: Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan answers the spectators' gardening, Camilla Bassett-Smith explores the spectacular garden on the coastal, Claire Lowrie advises how to prepare room plants for summer, and Katy Watson reveals how to plant smart for periods of droughts and heavy rainfall. / Alan odgovara na vrtlarska pitanje gledatelja, Camilla Bassett-Smith istražuje spektakularan vrt na priobalju, Claire Lowrie savjetuje kako pripremiti sobne biljke za ljeto, a Katy Watson otkriva kako saditi pametno za razdoblja suše i obilnih kiša.

programme.title: Putovanja za vikend s Greggom Wallaceom
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace knows what we need for the holiday mood, the Christmas fair. Therefore, he goes to Vienna, a city where the Christmas fairs have arisen, where it will discover what it takes for the fair to be perfect and how best to enjoy them. It will get to know the world of warm drinks, special decorations, interesting traditions, winter games and many treats. It will tell us why this city, which is held today, is held more than 50 fairs, the source of numerous British Christmas traditions. / Gregg Wallace zna što nam treba za blagdansko raspoloženje, božićni sajam. Stoga odlazi u Beč, grad u kojem su božićni sajmovi nastali, gdje će otkriti što je potrebno da bi sajam bio savršen i kako najbolje uživati u njima. Upoznat će svijet toplih napitaka, posebnih ukrasa, zanimljivih tradicija, zimskih igara i mnogo poslastica. Reći će nam zašto je taj grad, u kojem se danas održava više od 50 sajmova, izvor brojnih britanskih božićnih tradicija.

programme.title: Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: In the valleys such as Gastajna, Klajnarlic and Grosarla, old mountain villages are rooted, rooted in local customs. The Gastajn valley has been marked by mining for centuries. The former miners nurture a special custom: dancing with swords. Willi Huttegger is certainly one of the most innovative mountain peasants. By exploiting his mountain pasture and his trade on the estate in the valley, he managed to switch to full -time agriculture. Markus Schaidreiter is still a young peasant in the Klajnarla valley who, under the motto "One for All, All for One" in cooperation with two other engaged young farmers, managed to achieve the merger of all three rural farms. The three of them want to return to the roots of agriculture. / U dolinama kao što su Gastajnska, Klajnarlska i Grosarlska raštrkana su stara planinska sela, ukorijenjena u lokalnim običajima. Gastajnska dolina stoljećima je bila obilježena rudarstvom. Bivši rudari njeguju poseban običaj: ples s mačevima. Willi Huttegger jamačno je jedan od najinovativnijih gorskih seljaka. Iskorištavanjem svog planinskog pašnjaka i svojom trgovinom na imanju u dolini uspio se prebaciti na poljodjelstvo s punim radnim vremenom. Markus Schaidreiter još je mlad seljak u Klajnarlskoj dolini koji je pod geslom "jedan za sve, svi za jednoga" u suradnji s još dvojicom angažiranih mladih poljodjelaca uspio postići spajanje svih triju seoskih gospodarstava. Njih trojica žele se vratiti korijenima poljodjelstva.

Muči ih zla sreća _ recesija, gubitak posla i nadmašivanje ponuda za parcele stali su na put njihovu snu o samostalnoj gradnji. Napokon su osigurali parcelu u Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu i više nego ikad žele izgraditi svoj dom! Arhitekt John dizajnirao je prekrasan modernistički dio doma u koji će se povući: elegantno je to skrovište od životnih kušnji. No čim počnu s gradnjom, njihov nesretni niz se nastavlja. Zatvaranje zbog koronavirusa zaustavlja gradnju i svaki mjesec proveden u njihovoj skupoj unajmljenoj kući nagriza njihov ograničeni budžet te stoga ugrožava njihove planove za lagodnu mirovinu. programme.title: Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative pottery is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu's must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents _ and to some it does not fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. / Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja _ a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja.

Broadbent). programme.desc: Joanna and Ben build a magnificent American -style house in a rough part of Glasgow. Animator Joanna and carpenter Ben participate in the renovation of this city district and bring her a unique vision. Unutra će biti otvorena kuhinja i dnevni boravak s dvostrukim stropom osvijetljenim staklenim zidom. Ručno izrađeno stubište vodit će do dnevnog boravka na prvom katu i glavne spavaće sobe. Ali s ograničenim proračunom od 170.000 funti, Joanna i Ben si mogu priuštiti ovu ambicioznu kuću samo ako je sami izgrade. Problem je u tome što nikada prije nisu gradili kuću. Odlazi na hacijendu u Uxmalu, gdje obilazi plantaže citrusa, habanera i chaye te doznaje koji to sastojci recadose čine jedinstvenima, a mogu se naći samo na Yucatánu.

programme.title: Alan Titchmarsh: Pedeset nijansi zelene
programme.desc: On the occasion of the celebration of Alan Titchmarsh's 70th birthday and in honor of his fifty years of deeding gardening, a special show was filmed, which represents fifty of his favorite things. In this special episode, we celebrate horticulture throughout the United Kingdom, from ancient oaks to seasonal plants whose inflorescence can be missed in a tulle. We are moving where it all started in Alan's grandfather's garden, we travel across Britain: we will visit the royal Botanical gardens in Kew, Blenheim Palace and more, and in everything we will be helped by the famous Mary Berry and Griff Rhys Jones. This lavish production full of interesting things is designed in honor of the most popular British gardener. / U povodu proslave 70. rođendana Alana Titchmarsha i u čast njegovih pedeset godina bavljenja vrtlarstvom snimljena je posebna emisija koja predstavlja pedeset njemu najdražih stvari. U ovoj specijalnoj epizodi slavimo hortikulturu diljem Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od prastarih hrastova do sezonskih biljaka čiji cvat možete propustiti u tili čas. Krećemo ondje gdje je sve počelo _ u vrtu Alanovog djeda, putujemo diljem Britanije: posjetit ćemo Kraljevske botaničke vrtove u Kewu, palaču Blenheim i još mnogo toga, a u svemu će nam pomoći slavni Mary Berry i Griff Rhys Jones. Ova raskošna produkcija prepuna zanimljivosti osmišljena je u čast najpopularnijem britanskom vrtlaru.

Ovaj vrhunski chef s nekoliko Michelinovih zvjezdica pripremit će izvanredna slavljenička jela. Michel će unaprijed pripremiti svoje spektakularno predjelo bouillabaisse terrine. Sa svojim četverogodišnjim pranećakom Tomom ispeći će medenjake za drvce. Ispeći će i posebno božićno drvo, ali središnji dio njegove božićne gozbe bit će pečena svinjetina. A za Michela nema Božića bez njegovog omiljenog blagdanskog deserta _ soufflea s pijanim šljivama s Armagnacom.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: The Stockholm archipelago covers more than 30,000 islands and islets. This world begins just a few kilometers from the center of Stockholm, extends far into the Baltic Sea and has retained a large part of its original charm. Because most of the island can only be reached by sea. This islands for many Swedes are an ideal place to spend the summer in their own country. But the Stockholm archipelago did not go for summer visitors and tourists. On the islet of Grinda is a rural estate of Maria Jorgenson. It is not easy to deal with agriculture in this islands at all. The cows driving a boat here are the usual scene. Sanham's Thimig Johansen lives on Sandhamn. The first day of summer here is still celebrated in the traditional way. Maritimeness left a mark everywhere on the islands and between them. Per Nakkk Roni for wreckage and a trace for well -preserved ships from the Hanzeth era. As in what museum on the seabed, their remains rest: anchors, cannonballs, clay cubes and ship boards. / Štokholmski arhipelag obuhvaća više od 30.000 otoka i otočića. Taj svijet počinje samo nekoliko kilometara od središta Stockholma, proteže se daleko u Baltičko more i zadržao je velik dio svojeg izvornog šarma. Jer na većinu otoka može se doći samo morskim putem. Ovo je otočje za mnoge Šveđane idealno mjesto za provođenje ljeta u vlastitoj zemlji. No Štokholmski arhipelag nije idila samo za ljetne posjetitelje i turiste. Na otočiću Grinda seosko je imanje Marije Jorgensson. Baviti se poljodjelstvom na ovom otočju uopće nije lako. Krave koje se voze brodom ovdje su uobičajen prizor. Na Sandhamnu živi Sanna Thimmig Johansen. Prvi dan ljeta ovdje se još slavi na tradicionalan način. Pomorstvo je ostavilo traga posvuda na otocima i između njih. Per Normark roni za olupinama i traga za dobro očuvanim brodovima iz hanzeatskog doba. Kao u kakvu muzeju na morskom dnu počivaju njihovi ostaci: sidra, topovske kugle, glineni ćupovi i brodske daske.

programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Joanna and Ben build a magnificent American -style house in a rough part of Glasgow. Animator Joanna and carpenter Ben participate in the renovation of this city district and bring her a unique vision. Like the wild west buildings that inspire them, Joannina and Ben's house are like those on the ranch will be made of simple materials with a structural structure of dugglasia and fully coated with a rustic tin roof. The kitchen and living room with a double ceiling lit glass wall will be open inside. A handmade staircase will lead to the living room on the first floor and the main bedroom. But with a limited budget of £ 170,000, Joanna and Ben can afford this ambitious house only if they build it themselves. The problem is that they have never built a house before. Thus, with the help of their friend, carpenter Craig, they begin to learn the basic skills needed to build a ranch. / Joanna i Ben grade veličanstvenu kuću u stilu američkog ranča u grubom dijelu Glasgowa. Animatorica Joanna i stolar Ben sudjeluju u obnovi ove gradske četvrti i donose joj svoju jedinstvenu viziju. Poput zgrada Divljeg zapada koje ih inspiriraju, Joannina i Benova kuća nalik onima na ranču bit će izrađena od jednostavnih materijala sa strukturnom konstrukcijom od duglazije i u potpunosti obložena arišem s rustikalnim limenim krovom. Unutra će biti otvorena kuhinja i dnevni boravak s dvostrukim stropom osvijetljenim staklenim zidom. Ručno izrađeno stubište vodit će do dnevnog boravka na prvom katu i glavne spavaće sobe. Ali s ograničenim proračunom od 170.000 funti, Joanna i Ben si mogu priuštiti ovu ambicioznu kuću samo ako je sami izgrade. Problem je u tome što nikada prije nisu gradili kuću. programme.title: ART
programme.desc: During October, as part of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Fine Arts, the television ether becomes a place of artistic intervention. MultiDisciplinary artist Karlo Stefanek randomly interrupts the AAAAEEEEEEEEEEIIIIOOOOouuuu program randomly, playing with the voice, images, subjectivities and perceptions in the contemporary media environment. The work is part of his Self-Titled series (2022—), in which he explores identity instability and questioned the concepts of authorship and authenticity, using the body and (Auto) portrait as a space of discovery and resistance. In today's Art, we talk to Karl Štefanek about this project and his wider artistic practice, and then look at the history of television performance. / Tijekom listopada, u sklopu 60. zagrebačkog salona likovnih umjetnosti, televizijski eter postaje mjesto umjetničke intervencije.Multidisciplinarni umjetnik Karlo Štefanek nasumično prekida program performansom AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, poigravajući se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju. Rad je dio njegove serije Self-titled (2022—), u kojoj istražuje nestabilnost identiteta te propituje koncepte autorstva i autentičnosti, koristeći tijelo i (auto)portret kao prostor otkrivanja i otpora.U današnjem Artu razgovaramo s Karlom Štefanekom o ovom projektu i njegovoj široj umjetničkoj praksi, a potom se osvrćemo na povijest televizijskog performansa.

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle will visit Sandy this time, which opened a refuge for animals on the Greek island of Andros.
