Liburnia Jazz Festival bio je prva velika stepenica u svijet jazza za mnoge lokalne muzičare, pružajući im priliku ne samo da nastupe, nego i da dijele pozornicu s velikim svjetskim imenima poput Joea Zawinula, Hiromi, Mikea Sterna, Richarda Bone, Marie Joao, Medeskija, Martina And Wooda, a prošle godine i Richarda Galliana. Ove posebne godine festival je naglasio i svoju ulogu mjesta susreta _ okupljajući lokalne i inozemne glazbenike, različite kulture i muzičke tradicije, što je uvijek bila važna komponenta njegovog identiteta, zajedno s glazbom i različitim publikama.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film represents the authentic experience of three great personalities that manage to warm the human souls on three different continent for the "living word" shaped by tradition in "fairy tales and stories". Australian Susan Perrow, American Perry Ground and Croat Jasna Held testify to what "power and healing properties" of oral tradition opposite the damage that occurs exclusively with the "dead" technical mediation of stories in the 21st century. / Film predstavlja autentično iskustvo tri sjajne osobnosti koje na tri različita kontinenta uspijevaju zagrijati ljudske duše za "živu riječ" oblikovanu tradicijom u "bajke i priče". Australka Susan Perrow, Amerikanac Perry Ground i Hrvatica Jasna Held svjedoče kolika je "moć i ljekovitost" usmene tradicije nasuprot šteti koja nastaje isključivo "mrtvim" tehničkim posredovanjem priča u 21. stoljeću.

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film represents the authentic experience of three great personalities that manage to warm the human souls on three different continent for the "living word" shaped by tradition in "fairy tales and stories". Australian Susan Perrow, American Perry Ground and Croat Jasna Held testify to what "power and healing properties" of oral tradition opposite the damage that occurs exclusively with the "dead" technical mediation of stories in the 21st century. / Film predstavlja autentično iskustvo tri sjajne osobnosti koje na tri različita kontinenta uspijevaju zagrijati ljudske duše za "živu riječ" oblikovanu tradicijom u "bajke i priče". Australka Susan Perrow, Amerikanac Perry Ground i Hrvatica Jasna Held svjedoče kolika je "moć i ljekovitost" usmene tradicije nasuprot šteti koja nastaje isključivo "mrtvim" tehničkim posredovanjem priča u 21. stoljeću.

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and gestures of the screen coloring through autoportrators, TV performance aaaaeeeeeeiiiiooooooouuu is played with the voice, images, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering simultaneously meditative break and the space of critical reflection of usual tempo and content. The work of Karl Stefanek is aired as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: What did you do at war, Dad? / Što si radio u ratu, tata?
programme.desc: World War II. Commander Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) is tasked with winning a village of many Italian soldiers with a smaller group of people. To their huge surprise, they are welcomed by the cheerful Italian commander Oppo (S. Fantoni), who immediately, without struggle, teaching both the village and the soldiers, but under one unusual condition. Namely, zap. Cash villagers and Italian soldiers should be allowed to maintain another major celebration. Cash, known for holding on the rules firmly, reluctantly agreed after a long persuasion. At the celebration, fun and American and Italian soldiers and even Cash himself get drunk together. However, the agreed surrender the next day of waste due to the municipality of jealousy, because his previously dear Gin (G. Rali) spent the night with Commander Cash. War journalists photograph a "fight" from the air and there is a great misunderstanding and the whole world thinks that there is a great battle for survival in the village. Trged in lies, both sides agree that they will continue to play the fight for the village ... / Drugi svjetski rat. Zapovjednik Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) dobiva zadatak da s manjom grupom ljudi osvoji selo puno talijanskih vojnika. Na njihovo golemo iznenađenje dočekuje ih veseli talijanski zapovjednik Oppo (S. Fantoni) koji odmah, bez borbe, predaje i selo i vojnike, no pod jednim neobičnim uvjetom. Naime, zap. Cash seljanima i talijanskim vojnicima treba dopustiti da održe još jednu veliku proslavu. Cash, poznat po tome da se čvrsto drži pravila, nakon dugog nagovaranja nevoljko pristane. Na proslavi se zajedno napiju i zabave i američki i talijanski vojnici, pa čak i sam Cash. Međutim, dogovorena predaja sljedeći dan otpada zbog Oppove ljubomore, jer je njegova dotadašnja draga Gina (G. Rali) noć provela sa zapovjednikom Cashom. Ratni novinari fotografiraju "borbu" iz zraka te dolazi do velikog nesporazuma i cijeli svijet misli kako se u selu odvija velika bitka za opstanak. Zapletene u laži, obje se strane dogovore kako će i dalje glumiti borbu za selo...

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: During October, as part of the 60th Zagreb Salon of Fine Arts, the television ether becomes a place of artistic intervention. MultiDisciplinary artist Karlo Stefanek randomly interrupts the AAAAEEEEEEEEEEIIIIOOOOouuuu program randomly, playing with the voice, images, subjectivities and perceptions in the contemporary media environment. The work is part of his Self-Titled series (2022—), in which he explores identity instability and questioned the concepts of authorship and authenticity, using the body and (Auto) portrait as a space of discovery and resistance. In today's Art, we talk to Karl Štefanek about this project and his wider artistic practice, and then look at the history of television performance. / Tijekom listopada, u sklopu 60. zagrebačkog salona likovnih umjetnosti, televizijski eter postaje mjesto umjetničke intervencije.Multidisciplinarni umjetnik Karlo Štefanek nasumično prekida program performansom AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu, poigravajući se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju. Rad je dio njegove serije Self-titled (2022—), u kojoj istražuje nestabilnost identiteta te propituje koncepte autorstva i autentičnosti, koristeći tijelo i (auto)portret kao prostor otkrivanja i otpora.U današnjem Artu razgovaramo s Karlom Štefanekom o ovom projektu i njegovoj široj umjetničkoj praksi, a potom se osvrćemo na povijest televizijskog performansa.

programme.title: Izvan formata
programme.desc: When seven years ago, before Christmas on the Square of the Republic of Croatia, at number 8, the F8 Gallery opened, the students of photography of the Zagreb Academy of Dramatic Arts received the most beautiful holiday gift. In the past seven years, we have seen more than 40 exhibitions at this address that have gathered numerous visitors. And this is a confirmation that the F8 Gallery has outgrown the student gallery story and that it has become an important place that was missing on the Croatian photographic and artistic scene. These days, due to the risk of collapse of the facade and cracked sculptures on the Gallery building, the gallery had to move out. Agile professors and students of the Department of Photography have arranged a new exhibition space in the immediate vicinity and thus continued this beautiful gallery story. At the Gallery Studio and the Department of Photography, we talk to Professor Jelena Blagovic and photographer Gloria Lizda. And we were also at an interesting exam exhibition of students of the photography of Vida Redz and David Bakaric Mihaljevic. / Kada je prije sedam godina uoči Božića na Trgu Republike Hrvatske na broju 8 otvorena Galerija f8, studenti fotografije zagrebačke Akademije dramske umjetnosti dobili su najljepši blagdanski poklon. U proteklih sedam godina na toj smo adresi vidjeli više od 40 izložbi koje su okupljale brojne posjetitelje. A to je potvrda da je Galerija f8 prerasla studentsku galerijsku priču te da je postala važno mjesto koje je nedostajalo na hrvatskoj fotografskoj i umjetničkoj sceni. Ovih dana zbog opasnosti od urušavanja fasade i napuklih skulptura na zgradi Galerija se morala iseliti. Agilni profesori i studenti Katedre za fotografiju uredili su u neposrednoj blizini novi izložbeni prostor i tako nastavili ovu lijepu galerijsku priču. U studiju o Galeriji i Katedri za fotografiju ADU razgovaramo s profesoricom Jelenom Blagović i fotografkinjom Glorijom Lizde. A bili smo i na zanimljivoj ispitnoj izložbi studenata fotografije Vida Redže i Davida Bakarića Mihaljevića.

programme.title: Groznica
programme.desc: The episode studies the key role of wood throughout human history and that the search for this most deaverment goods, which is now the basis of the industry of the billions of dollars, dictates our history, present and future. By discovering the secret structures of trees, we study the resistance of wooden buildings in Japan and the importance of wooden ships for the formation of empires. Going to the future, we explore the role of wood in modern human activities and the transition of the construction industry to the environmentally conscious construction, emphasizing the timeless importance of wood as a fundamental resource and leader of innovation. / Epizoda proučava ključnu ulogu drva kroz ljudsku povijest te kako potraga za tom najdrevnijom robom, koja je sada temelj industrije vrijedne milijarde dolara, diktira našu povijest, sadašnjost i budućnost. Otkrivajući tajne strukture stabala, proučavamo otpornost drvenih građevina u Japanu i važnost drvenih brodova za nastanak carstava. Prelazeći na budućnost, istražujemo ulogu drva u modernim ljudskim aktivnostima te prelazak građevinske industrije na ekološki osviještenu gradnju, naglašavajući bezvremensku važnost drva kao temeljnog resursa te predvodnika inovacije.

programme.title: Countries - people - adventures / Zemlje - ljudi - pustolovine
programme.desc: Newfoundland has always been different from the rest of Canada. The Canadian film crew made NDR in six different places in this extraordinarily beautiful end of special people. These are coastal cities without road connections, so they can only be reached by boat. There are then cowboys of ice hills that do not catch the wild horses with Lasa but icebergs. And that is the end with the greatest density of the poet in the country. Newfoundland has only been a Canadian province since 1949 and has always been different from the rest of the country. This movie with a lot of love represents special people of that area. / Newfoundland se uvijek razlikovao od ostatka Kanade. Kanadska filmska ekipa snimala je za NDR na šest različitih mjesta u ovom izvanredno lijepom kraju posebnih ljudi. Obalni su to gradovi bez cestovnih priključaka pa se do njih može doći samo brodom. Tu su zatim kauboji ledenih bregova koji lasom ne hvataju divlje konje nego ledene sante. A to je i kraj s najvećom gustoćom pjesnika u zemlji. Newfoundland je tek od 1949. kanadska pokrajina i oduvijek je drukčija od ostatka zemlje. Ovaj film s mnogo ljubavi predstavlja posebne ljude toga kraja.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Mirko Zrinšćak lives on Učka, 950 meters above sea level, in Icici. Although he graduated from painting in Venice in Venice, wood is his basic expressive medium. An artist who, as a seafarer, sailed the world, chooses a way of life in which, separated from the restlessness and acceleration of the modern city, forms sculpture and facilities in the studio located in the building of the former school. Zrinšćak's motifs are often their own sculptures, collected objects, preserved memories ... / Mirko Zrinšćak živi na Učki, na 950 metara nadmorske visine, u mjestu Ičići. Premda je na Likovnoj akademiji u Veneciji završio slikarstvo, drvo je njegov osnovni izražajni medij. Umjetnik koji je kao pomorac oplovio svijet, odabire način života u kojem, odvojen od nemira i ubrzanja suvremenog grada, oblikuje skulpture i objekte u atelijeru smještenom u zgradi nekadašnje škole. Motivi Zrinšćakovih fotografija često su vlastite skulpture, skupljeni predmeti, sačuvane uspomene...

programme.title: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and gestures of the screen coloring through autoportrators, TV performance aaaaeeeeeeiiiiooooooouuu is played with the voice, images, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering simultaneously meditative break and the space of critical reflection of usual tempo and content. The work of Karl Stefanek is aired as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: ART
programme.desc: Art _ Your Culture Address! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 8.10pm, we bring you the best from the art world and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Talking for a reason is longtime correspondent Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk to him about why he is so captivated by the past and the way we handle it. How much was his interest in the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is the correct claim that Germany was to blame for the process? What were the relations of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tudjman? What do the documents he explored about the relationship between Croatian politics to BiH at the time are revealed? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ There are many reasons to talk to Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.title: Simpsoni
programme.desc: Marge and Mr. Burns are fighting for the affection of the deliberate young Football player. / Marge i g. Burns bore se za naklonost umišljenoga mladog igrača footballa.

programme.title: Zemlja obećanja
programme.desc: Night in the Sinai desert. A group of men and women warms around the fire under the clear sky. Women are from Eastern Europe. Men are Bedouins who pass with their flocks with this area. Tomorrow he will secretly cross the border. Tomorrow, Diana and others will beat, rape and sell. They will go from one to the other. Anne will sell them to Hanna's club. It will become victims of an international network selling women. Diana will meet Rose one night at the club. Will ask for help. Their encounter is a glimmer of hope in hell that these women live through. It is a difficult, engaged drama that criticizes and explores the global problem of modern slavery. / Noć u Sinajskoj pustinji. Skupina muškaraca i žena grije se oko vatre pod vedrim nebom. Žene su iz istočne Europe. Muškarci su beduini koji ovim krajem prolaze sa svojim stadima. Sutra će potajno prijeći granicu. Sutra će Dianu i ostale tući, silovati i prodati. Ići će od jednih do drugih. Anne će ih prodati Hanninom klubu. Postat će žrtvama međunarodne mreže koja prodaje žene. Diana će jedne noći u klubu upoznati Rose. Zatražit će pomoć. Njihov je susret tračak nade u pakle koje te žene proživljavaju. Riječ je o teškoj, angažiranoj drami koja kritizira i istražuje globalni problem modernog ropstva.

programme.title: Graditelj brodova
programme.desc: The shipbuilder Mato Dučević from the Peljesac peninsula crossed eighty, and still from morning to dusk for his suto. He is one of the last and perhaps the last traditional shipbuilder. Mato can build a ship independently _ from receiving an order, draft designing, choosing wood to long shaping. The movie about Mr. Mother is a story about persistence, talent, pleasure and enjoyment of this difficult job. / Brodograditelj Mato Dužević s poluotoka Pelješca prešao je osamdesetu, a još uvijek od jutra do sutona radi. Jedan je od posljednjih, a možda i zadnji tradicionalni graditelj brodova. Mato može samostalno sagraditi brod _ od primanja narudžbe, izrade nacrta, odabira drveta do dugotrajnog oblikovanja. Film o gosparu Mati priča je o upornosti, talentu, zadovoljstvu i uživanju u ovom teškom poslu.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: In the episode "Once upon a time ... _ Digital fairy tale for adults" about the fate of stories and the importance of oral tradition in the digital world is witnessed by scientists and experts of various profiles, as well as those who still tell stories ... Who still need Palcic, Crvenkapic or Baba Jaga? How do cell phones, games, TV and internet culture change the personality and being of a child? What is the importance of a living person (narrator) in the development of a child _ man? Family "documentary" for every parent with the message "The stories should not disappear!" / U epizodi "JEDNOM DAVNO... _ digitalna bajka za odrasle" o sudbini priča i važnosti usmene tradicije u digitalnom svijetu svjedoče znanstvenici i stručnjaci raznih profila, kao i oni koji još uvijek pričaju priče... Kome još trebaju Palčić, Crvenkapica ili baba Jaga? Na koji način mobiteli, igrice, TV i internetska kultura mijenjaju osobnost i biće djeteta? Kolika je važnost žive osobe (pripovjedača) u razvoju djeteta _ čovjeka? Obiteljski "dokumentarac" za svakog roditelja s porukom "Priče ne smiju nestati!"

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: Goodway mayor thinks she can change bad dogs from a terrible team by turning that she is a bad fairy tale and joining the team. When the Gasket puts the mayor for testing, the puppies must save her. / Gradonačelnica Goodway misli da može promijeniti zločeste psiće iz Strašne ekipe pretvaranjem da je zločesta bajkerica i učlanjivanjem u ekipu. Kada Gasket stavi Gradonačelnicu na testiranje, psići je moraju spasiti.

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. We wish you a great party with Krcek! You are also awaiting rhymes and computer games! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. programme.title: I love animals zoo / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I love the ZOO animals, we meet animals at the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping at the Zoo. Every day for him is a new challenge, because he gets a special task that he cannot do if he does not learn something about daily activities at the zoo _ diet, cleaning and decoration of dwelling, playing, training or treatment of animals. In this episode, one of the animals should go to another zoo and Mark's task is to prepare a crate for transportation. In order for the animal to really get into the crate, it should be trained daily. Marko will see how animals are training and for transportation, but also stinging, weighing or veterinary examination. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju, treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U ovoj epizodi jedna od životinja treba otići u drugi zoološki vrt i Markov je zadatak pripremiti sanduk za prijevoz. Da bi životinja doista i ušla u sanduk, treba je svakodnevno trenirati. Marko će vidjeti kako se to životinje treniraju i radi transporta, ali i razgibavanja, vaganja ili veterinarskog pregleda.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: In the episode "Once upon a time ... _ Digital fairy tale for adults" about the fate of stories and the importance of oral tradition in the digital world is witnessed by scientists and experts of various profiles, as well as those who still tell stories ... Who still need Palcic, Crvenkapic or Baba Jaga? How do cell phones, games, TV and internet culture change the personality and being of a child? What is the importance of a living person (narrator) in the development of a child _ man? Family "documentary" for every parent with the message "The stories should not disappear!" / U epizodi "JEDNOM DAVNO... _ digitalna bajka za odrasle" o sudbini priča i važnosti usmene tradicije u digitalnom svijetu svjedoče znanstvenici i stručnjaci raznih profila, kao i oni koji još uvijek pričaju priče... Kome još trebaju Palčić, Crvenkapica ili baba Jaga? Na koji način mobiteli, igrice, TV i internetska kultura mijenjaju osobnost i biće djeteta? Kolika je važnost žive osobe (pripovjedača) u razvoju djeteta _ čovjeka? Obiteljski "dokumentarac" za svakog roditelja s porukom "Priče ne smiju nestati!"

In the first story, located in Paris, a group of friends kills acquaintances for jealousy and money. In Rome, a student is involved in a smuggling chain who also leads him to murder, and in London the unfulfilled poet wants to earn earn on the fact that he has found a female corpse. / U tri različite priče film se bavi ubojstvima koje su počinili pripadnici dobrostojeće mladeži. U prvoj priči, smještenoj u Parizu, skupina prijatelja ubija poznanika zbog ljubomore i novca. U Rimu student biva upleten u krijumčarski lanac koji ga dovede i do ubojstva, a u Londonu neostvareni pjesnik želi zaraditi na činjenici da je pronašao ženski leš.

programme.title: Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: The guest of the show Talking for a reason is longtime correspondent Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe _ German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk to him about why he is so captivated by the past and the way we handle it. How much was his interest in the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia _ and is the correct claim that Germany was to blame for the process? What were the relations of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tudjman? What do the documents he explored about the relationship between Croatian politics to BiH at the time are revealed? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe _ There are many reasons to talk to Michael Martens. / Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu _ njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije _ i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi _ mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Olympus with a height of 2918 m is the highest mountain in Greece, in Greek mythology, the headquarters of Zeus and his sublime divine companion. Not far from him, he pushed the peninsula with the forests of Platan, olive groves, old mountain villages and magical bays. Only world-renowned meteori monasteries that have been included in the UNESCO World Heritage List. These holy places are erected on pointed rocks. Maria Zolota and her husband Dionysos lead a mountaineering home to Spilios Agapitos at 2060 m. Each season here to spend more than 10,000 guests, which requires many organizational gifts and work. Water is brought in a special water supply system from the highlands. It is water of melted snow and ice. The supply of foods should also be organized as there is no freight cable car or access road here. But that's why there is Takis and his donkey express. Panaiotis varpipes and his girlfriend Litsa hunters are on truffles. With their dogs in the forest, Kalambake regularly searches for these black gold. / Olimp je s visinom od 2918 m najviša planina u Grčkoj, u grčkoj mitologiji sjedište Zeusa i njegove uzvišene božanske družine. Nedaleko od njega je poluotok Pilio sa šumama platana, maslinicima, starim planinskim selima i čarobnim uvalama. Svu tu ljepotu nadilaze samo svjetski poznati manastiri Meteora koji su uvršteni u UNESCO-v popis Svjetske kulturne baštine. Ta su sveta mjesta podignuta na šiljastim stijenama. Maria Zolota i njezin muž Dionysos vode planinarski dom u Spilios Agapitosu na 2060 m. Svake sezone ovdje prenoći više od 10.000 gostiju, za što je potrebno mnogo organizacijskog dara i radinosti. Voda se posebnim vodovodom dovodi iz gorja. To je voda od otopljenog snijega i leda. Treba organizirati i opskrbu namirnicama jer ovdje nema teretne žičare ni pristupne ceste. Ali zato postoji Takis i njegov magareći ekspres. Panaiotis Varipatis i njegova djevojka Litsa lovci su na tartufe. Sa svojim psima u šumi Kalambake redovito tragaju za tim crnim zlatom.

programme.title: Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein's musical directed by Leo Mujić, June 14, 2025, CNT Ivan pl. Rijeka. At the end of the 2024/2025 season, June 14, 2025, a musical of stories from the western side of Leonard Bernstein of 1957, for the first time in the Croatian language, in Borivoj Radakovic, was premiered in Rijeka. The idea came from Dubravka Vrgoc's intendant and opera director, conductor Valentin Egel, in order to connect all the ensembles of the Croatian National Theater Ivan pl. Zajc with guest soloists. The director was entrusted to a favorite choreographer with the experience of Zagreb's comedy hits, Leo Mujic, who re -hired his colleague Balint Rauscher for dramatization, and for set designer Stefan Katunar. Of the many roles that intertwine among the permanent employees of the ensembles and external associates selected in audition, we meet the entertainment stars such as Damir Kedz (Toni) and Franka Batelic Corluka (Anita), and some new young faces such as Katarina Margaretic (Maria), Ivan Cuic (Bernardo), Devin Juraj, Dorian Stipcic (Diesel) and Deni Sankovic (Chino). From the diverse profile of the artist of Rijeka theater, we certainly highlight Ballerina Tea Rušin as a seducer Velma and the Italian drama actress Elena Brumini as an Anybody temperamental boy. All together makes a great show whose highlights we bring in a half -hour reportage, but which must still look live for a complete first -hand experience. / Mjuzikl Leonarda Bernsteina u režiji Lea Mujića, 14. lipnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Krajem sezone 2024./2025., 14. lipnja 2025., u Rijeci je premijerno uprizoren mjuzikl Priča sa Zapadne strane Leonarda Bernsteina iz 1957., prvi put na hrvatskom jeziku, u prepjevu Borivoja Radakovića. Ideja je potekla od intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč i direktora opere, dirigenta Valentina Egela, ne bi li se u završnici sezone u stvaranju popularnog naslova povezali svi ansambli Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta Ivana pl. Zajca uz gostujuće soliste. Režija je povjerena omiljenom koreografu s iskustvom zagrebačkih Komedijinih uspješnica, Leu Mujiću, koji je za dramatizaciju ponovno angažirao kolegu Balinta Rauschera, a za scenografa Stefana Katunara. Od mnoštva uloga koje se isprepleću među stalno zaposlenima u ansamblima, ali i vanjskih suradnika probranih na audiciji, ovdje susrećemo estradne zvijezde poput Damira Kedže (Toni) i Franke Batelić Ćorluke (Anita), te neka nova mlada lica kao što su Katarina Margaretić (Maria), Ivan Čuić (Bernardo), Devin Juraj (Riff), Dorian Stipčić (Diesel) i Deni Sanković (Chino). Iz raznolikog profila umjetnika riječkoga kazališta svakako izdvajamo balerinu Teu Rušin kao zavodnicu Velmu i glumicu Talijanske drame Elenu Brumini u ulozi temperamentnog dječaka Anybodyja. Sve skupa čini vrsnu predstavu čije vrhunce donosimo u polusatnoj reportaži, ali koja se za potpuni doživljaj iz prve ruke ipak mora pogledati uživo.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: If it is true that today it is increasingly difficult, in a stylistic sense, to answer the question "What is jazz?", This is not a cause for concern. On the contrary, the jazz should first and foremost be a music that is constantly redefined, which may have been best embodied by Miles Davis: the music that you upset the next moment when you thought you had caught her by the tail. More than style, jazz is _ at least in the theory of _ Open -door house, into which everyone is welcome. How much will be held in it, as musicians or listeners, depends on their openness to the unpredictable, especially the one that results from spontaneous interaction. In this sense, although it is sometimes experienced by the crash and exclusive, the jazz actually music of a living encounter and collective experience _ whether in common music, either in front of the audience. This idea is also based on the Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, which in a special way connects the high -level musical camp and the concert program. During the day, workshops, gatherings and masterclasses are held with mentors, while evenings dedicated to public performances of distinguished guests and Jam sessions where all participants, through mutual music, blend in various musical traditions and influences. The third edition of the festival, held from August 28 to August 30, completely immersed in the atmosphere of the island, continued to build great foundations laid by vocalist Than Alex and the creative platform of Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanovic. The concert program and the mentoring team consisted of saxophonist Ben Wendel and vocalists Sofia Rey and Michael Mayo, along with members of their accompanying bands. They led workshops, lectures and conversations with a selected group of musicians from all over the world, including those from Croatia. The whole program, as the main mentor and master festival, presided over by Terri Lyne Carrington, a multi -award -winning drummer and Grammy winner. At the end of the day, the participants presented their intense work to the Lopudic audience without the storm stronger than the spirit of Jazz, showed the successful relocation of a part of the performance in the Lopudic Rector's Palace _, which, in addition to his historical beauty, also showed how perfectly he agreed with the liveliness of new, exciting music. / Ako je točno da je danas sve teže, u stilskom smislu, odgovoriti na pitanje "Što je jazz?", to nije razlog za zabrinutost. Naprotiv _ jazz bi prije svega trebao biti glazba koja se neprestano redefinira, što je možda najbolje utjelovio Miles Davis: glazba koja vam u sljedećem trenutku izmakne baš kad ste pomislili da ste je uhvatili za rep. Više od stila, jazz je _ barem u teoriji _ kuća otvorenih vrata, u koju su svi dobrodošli. Koliko će se u njoj zadržati, kao glazbenici ili slušatelji, ovisi o njihovoj otvorenosti prema nepredvidivom, osobito onom koje proizlazi iz spontane interakcije. U tom je smislu, premda ga se katkad doživljava zakučastim i isključivim, jazz zapravo glazba živog susreta i kolektivnog iskustva _ bilo u zajedničkom muziciranju, bilo pred publikom. Na toj ideji temelji se i Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, koji na poseban način spaja glazbeni kamp visoke razine i koncertni program. Tijekom dana održavaju se radionice, druženja i masterclassovi s mentorima, dok su večeri posvećene javnim nastupima uglednih gostiju i jam sessionima u kojima svi sudionici, kroz međusobno muziciranje, stapaju različite glazbene tradicije i utjecaje. Treće izdanje festivala, održano od 28. do 30. kolovoza, u potpunosti uronjeno u atmosferu otoka, nastavilo je graditi sjajne temelje koje su postavili vokalistica Thana Alexa i Kreativna platforma Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. Koncertni program i mentorski tim činili su saksofonist Ben Wendel te vokalisti Sofia Rey i Michael Mayo, zajedno s članovima svojih pratećih sastava. Vodili su radionice, predavanja i razgovore s odabranom skupinom glazbenika iz cijelog svijeta, uključujući i one iz Hrvatske. Cijelim je programom, kao glavna mentorica i master festivala, predsjedala Terri Lyne Carrington, višestruko nagrađivana bubnjarka i dobitnica Grammyja. Svoj su intenzivan rad sudionici na kraju dana predstavili lopudskoj publici, a da ni oluja nije jača od duha jazza, pokazalo je uspješno preseljenje dijela izvedbi u lopudski Knežev dvor _ koji je, osim svoje povijesne ljepote, pokazao i kako savršeno pristaje uz živost nove, uzbudljive glazbe.

programme.title: The key to happiness / Ključ sreće
programme.desc: Ivan Rabuzin (1921 _ 2008) graduated from the Master Department of the Craft School in Zagreb in 1948 and attended an evening drawing course. And although this teaching makes the basis of his fine arts, Rabuzin will remain self -taught that looks around the world around him with the eyes of a first -grandson, so he cannot rely on someone else's experience and taken over, borrowed form. They met him around the world and there is almost no Western European countries whose galleries and museums are not guarded by Rabuzin's works, and his unique and distinctive style has been seen in the US, Russia and the distant Japan. The life and work of Ivan Rabuzin, a Croatian world -renowned naive painter, born in the village of Ključ near Novi Marof, where he spent his entire life and welcomed a deep age, tells the documentary "Key of Happiness". / Ivan Rabuzin (1921. _ 2008.) završio je majstorski odjel Obrtne škole u Zagrebu 1948. i polazio večernji tečaj crtanja. I premda ta poduka čini temelj njegove likovne kulture, Rabuzin će ostati samouk koji svijet oko sebe gleda očima prvodošloga, pa se ne može osloniti na tuđe iskustvo i preuzetu, posuđenu formu. Upoznali su ga širom svijeta i gotovo da nema zapadnoeuropske zemlje u čijim se galerijama i muzejima ne čuvaju Rabuzinova djela, a njegov jedinstven i prepoznatljiv stil viđen je i u SAD-u, Rusiji te dalekom Japanu. O životu i radu Ivana Rabuzina, hrvatskog slikara naive svjetskoga glasa, rođenom u selu Ključ pokraj Novog Marofa, gdje je proveo cijeli život te dočekao duboku starost, govori dokumentarni film "Ključ sreće".

programme.title: Alan Carr u pustolovinama s Agathom Christie
programme.desc: Alan Carr reveals the traces of the greatest writer of criminal stories of all time, Agatha Christie. She meets fellow fans, like Reverend Richard Cole, and visits locations such as Burgh Island and Greenway House, who have influenced some of her most successful novels. / Alan Carr otkriva tragove najveće spisateljice kriminalističkih priča svih vremena, Agathe Christie. Pritom se susreće s kolegama obožavateljima, poput velečasnog Richarda Colea, i obilazi lokacije kao što su Burgh Island i Greenway House, koje su utjecale na nastanak nekih od njezinih najuspješnijih romana.

The work of Karl Stefanek is aired as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Poraženi
programme.desc: In three different stories, the film deals with the killings committed by members of a well -to -do youth. In the first story, located in Paris, a group of friends kills acquaintances for jealousy and money. In Rome, a student is involved in a smuggling chain who also leads him to murder, and in London the unfulfilled poet wants to earn earn on the fact that he has found a female corpse. / U tri različite priče film se bavi ubojstvima koje su počinili pripadnici dobrostojeće mladeži. U prvoj priči, smještenoj u Parizu, skupina prijatelja ubija poznanika zbog ljubomore i novca. U Rimu student biva upleten u krijumčarski lanac koji ga dovede i do ubojstva, a u Londonu neostvareni pjesnik želi zaraditi na činjenici da je pronašao ženski leš.

programme.title: Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: The most famous photo of August Frajtić (1902 _ 1977) is a dynamically composed image of a village harvest to which the iconic bread was given to our daily bread. The photograph was taken in 1939, at a time when Frajtić, as the initiator and organizer of the Zagreb photo amateur movement, influenced the formation of photographic opinion of many generations of Croatian artists, and encouraged the creation of national style in art photography through educational work. / Najpoznatija fotografija Augusta Frajtića (1902. _ 1977.) dinamično je komponirana slika seoske žetve kojoj je dao znakovit naslov Kruh naš svagdanji. Fotografija je nastala 1939. godine, u vrijeme kada je Frajtić, kao pokretač i organizator zagrebačkog fotoamaterskog pokreta, utjecao na formiranje fotografskog mišljenja mnogih naraštaja hrvatskih umjetnika, a odgojnim radom potaknuo stvaranje nacionalnog stila u umjetničkoj fotografiji.

programme.title: Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein's musical directed by Leo Mujić, June 14, 2025, CNT Ivan pl. Rijeka. At the end of the 2024/2025 season, June 14, 2025, a musical of stories from the western side of Leonard Bernstein of 1957, for the first time in the Croatian language, in Borivoj Radakovic, was premiered in Rijeka. The idea came from Dubravka Vrgoc's intendant and opera director, conductor Valentin Egel, in order to connect all the ensembles of the Croatian National Theater Ivan pl. Zajc with guest soloists. The director was entrusted to a favorite choreographer with the experience of Zagreb's comedy hits, Leo Mujic, who re -hired his colleague Balint Rauscher for dramatization, and for set designer Stefan Katunar. Of the many roles that intertwine among the permanent employees of the ensembles and external associates selected in audition, we meet the entertainment stars such as Damir Kedz (Toni) and Franka Batelic Corluka (Anita), and some new young faces such as Katarina Margaretic (Maria), Ivan Cuic (Bernardo), Devin Juraj, Dorian Stipcic (Diesel) and Deni Sankovic (Chino). From the diverse profile of the artist of Rijeka theater, we certainly highlight Ballerina Tea Rušin as a seducer Velma and the Italian drama actress Elena Brumini as an Anybody temperamental boy. All together makes a great show whose highlights we bring in a half -hour reportage, but which must still look live for a complete first -hand experience. / Mjuzikl Leonarda Bernsteina u režiji Lea Mujića, 14. lipnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Krajem sezone 2024./2025., 14. lipnja 2025., u Rijeci je premijerno uprizoren mjuzikl Priča sa Zapadne strane Leonarda Bernsteina iz 1957., prvi put na hrvatskom jeziku, u prepjevu Borivoja Radakovića. Ideja je potekla od intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč i direktora opere, dirigenta Valentina Egela, ne bi li se u završnici sezone u stvaranju popularnog naslova povezali svi ansambli Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta Ivana pl. Zajca uz gostujuće soliste. Režija je povjerena omiljenom koreografu s iskustvom zagrebačkih Komedijinih uspješnica, Leu Mujiću, koji je za dramatizaciju ponovno angažirao kolegu Balinta Rauschera, a za scenografa Stefana Katunara. Od mnoštva uloga koje se isprepleću među stalno zaposlenima u ansamblima, ali i vanjskih suradnika probranih na audiciji, ovdje susrećemo estradne zvijezde poput Damira Kedže (Toni) i Franke Batelić Ćorluke (Anita), te neka nova mlada lica kao što su Katarina Margaretić (Maria), Ivan Čuić (Bernardo), Devin Juraj (Riff), Dorian Stipčić (Diesel) i Deni Sanković (Chino). Iz raznolikog profila umjetnika riječkoga kazališta svakako izdvajamo balerinu Teu Rušin kao zavodnicu Velmu i glumicu Talijanske drame Elenu Brumini u ulozi temperamentnog dječaka Anybodyja. Sve skupa čini vrsnu predstavu čije vrhunce donosimo u polusatnoj reportaži, ali koja se za potpuni doživljaj iz prve ruke ipak mora pogledati uživo.

programme.title: Svijet jazza
programme.desc: If it is true that today it is increasingly difficult, in a stylistic sense, to answer the question "What is jazz?", This is not a cause for concern. On the contrary, the jazz should first and foremost be a music that is constantly redefined, which may have been best embodied by Miles Davis: the music that you upset the next moment when you thought you had caught her by the tail. More than style, jazz is _ at least in the theory of _ Open -door house, into which everyone is welcome. How much will be held in it, as musicians or listeners, depends on their openness to the unpredictable, especially the one that results from spontaneous interaction. In this sense, although it is sometimes experienced by the crash and exclusive, the jazz actually music of a living encounter and collective experience _ whether in common music, either in front of the audience. This idea is also based on the Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, which in a special way connects the high -level musical camp and the concert program. During the day, workshops, gatherings and masterclasses are held with mentors, while evenings dedicated to public performances of distinguished guests and Jam sessions where all participants, through mutual music, blend in various musical traditions and influences. The third edition of the festival, held from August 28 to August 30, completely immersed in the atmosphere of the island, continued to build great foundations laid by vocalist Than Alex and the creative platform of Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanovic. The concert program and the mentoring team consisted of saxophonist Ben Wendel and vocalists Sofia Rey and Michael Mayo, along with members of their accompanying bands. They led workshops, lectures and conversations with a selected group of musicians from all over the world, including those from Croatia. The whole program, as the main mentor and master festival, presided over by Terri Lyne Carrington, a multi -award -winning drummer and Grammy winner. At the end of the day, the participants presented their intense work to the Lopudic audience without the storm stronger than the spirit of Jazz, showed the successful relocation of a part of the performance in the Lopudic Rector's Palace _, which, in addition to his historical beauty, also showed how perfectly he agreed with the liveliness of new, exciting music. / Ako je točno da je danas sve teže, u stilskom smislu, odgovoriti na pitanje "Što je jazz?", to nije razlog za zabrinutost. Naprotiv _ jazz bi prije svega trebao biti glazba koja se neprestano redefinira, što je možda najbolje utjelovio Miles Davis: glazba koja vam u sljedećem trenutku izmakne baš kad ste pomislili da ste je uhvatili za rep. Više od stila, jazz je _ barem u teoriji _ kuća otvorenih vrata, u koju su svi dobrodošli. Koliko će se u njoj zadržati, kao glazbenici ili slušatelji, ovisi o njihovoj otvorenosti prema nepredvidivom, osobito onom koje proizlazi iz spontane interakcije. U tom je smislu, premda ga se katkad doživljava zakučastim i isključivim, jazz zapravo glazba živog susreta i kolektivnog iskustva _ bilo u zajedničkom muziciranju, bilo pred publikom. Na toj ideji temelji se i Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, koji na poseban način spaja glazbeni kamp visoke razine i koncertni program. Tijekom dana održavaju se radionice, druženja i masterclassovi s mentorima, dok su večeri posvećene javnim nastupima uglednih gostiju i jam sessionima u kojima svi sudionici, kroz međusobno muziciranje, stapaju različite glazbene tradicije i utjecaje. Treće izdanje festivala, održano od 28. do 30. kolovoza, u potpunosti uronjeno u atmosferu otoka, nastavilo je graditi sjajne temelje koje su postavili vokalistica Thana Alexa i Kreativna platforma Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. Koncertni program i mentorski tim činili su saksofonist Ben Wendel te vokalisti Sofia Rey i Michael Mayo, zajedno s članovima svojih pratećih sastava. Vodili su radionice, predavanja i razgovore s odabranom skupinom glazbenika iz cijelog svijeta, uključujući i one iz Hrvatske. Cijelim je programom, kao glavna mentorica i master festivala, predsjedala Terri Lyne Carrington, višestruko nagrađivana bubnjarka i dobitnica Grammyja. Svoj su intenzivan rad sudionici na kraju dana predstavili lopudskoj publici, a da ni oluja nije jača od duha jazza, pokazalo je uspješno preseljenje dijela izvedbi u lopudski Knežev dvor _ koji je, osim svoje povijesne ljepote, pokazao i kako savršeno pristaje uz živost nove, uzbudljive glazbe.

programme.title: Zadržani nakon dolaska
programme.desc: Diego, Venezuela's urbanist, and his partner Elena, a Barcelona dancer, arrive in the US to start a new life. However, at the immigration department of the airport, they stand out to the additional test room. The seemingly routine control is converted to an exhausting examination that reveals their secrets and puts their relationship to their temptation. / Diego, urbanist iz Venezuele, i njegova partnerica Elena, plesačica iz Barcelone, stižu u SAD kako bi započeli novi život. No, na imigracijskom odjelu zračne luke izdvajaju ih u prostoriju za dodatno ispitivanje. Naizgled rutinska kontrola pretvara se u iscrpljujuće ispitivanje koje razotkriva njihove tajne i stavlja na kušnju njihov odnos.

programme.title: Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: As part of the 11th Split Blues Festival, the Croatian Bluesers from the Homeland and Diaspora held a full -time concert. Thus, Croatian Blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, as well as from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Zagreb, Hvar, Solina, Veliki Trgovišće performed: Tony Lee King And Southern Cooking and Charlie and Bell Blues Experience, which are this year's winners of Croatian Blues Challenge and Croatian representatives at the World Blues Competition in Memphis. / U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco And Southern Cooking te Charlie And Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The movie "About People and Stories" from the Cycle "I Talk You Story" is a very personal "story of the story" by director Mladen Santric, and the last work / Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The HTV Education and Science Department, in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute, has recorded thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Stokavian and Chakavian dialects and unusual names of the place, but also of the frequent and unusual personal names. The head of the interview is the Croatian language professor Katarina Marjanovic, who gives numerous followers on Instagram. Her interviewees are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijevic, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidovic, Ivana Kurtovic Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivancevic, Ana Radmilovic, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stankovic and Viktor Nenadic and Branimir Volf with the support of colleagues from the web HRT department Ive Hren and Matko Svarc and Tomislav Mrsic and Maja Fišter. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter.

programme.title: Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories of sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active being called "sound collector", which has a passion for sound and all the concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he hears very poorly. This small being spends his days discovering and learning new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are the most common sounds of the sea, sounds that produce beings in the sea, the sounds produced by insects, including snoring his best friend and pet Marta. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The terrible team started jumping by bus, and the motorcycle puppies must save them from high winding up. // Chase's cat allergies take him to the desert, where he is captured by a terrible team. Moto puppies go into epic rescue! / Strašna ekipa krenula je autobusom na skakanje, a Moto psići ih moraju spasiti s Visoke vijugave gore. // Chaseove mačje alergije odvedu ga u pustinju, gdje ga zarobi Strašna ekipa. Moto psići kreću u epsko spašavanje!

programme.title: Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just been three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the herd, he used to being all over his. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. In each episode, one day is shown in kindergarten. The daily routine of the only crazy toddler disrupts. Through various events and accidents, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki is a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanuts. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they fall into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem, they always invent a machine. The machine does not always work the way they imagined and emerge many humorous and unforeseen situations. / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije.

programme.title: Krceki - song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: In addition to the animated series of Krceki, we are also coming to us by seven rhymes: bragger, plack, smart, good, angry, shy and brave. Each rhyme sings about the features of one character from the Krceki series. Music, Verses, Performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Authors of the series: Denis Alenta, Vjekoslav Zivkovic, Marija Ivsic Editor: Sanja Nakic / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: I love animals zoo / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I love the ZOO animals, we meet animals at the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping at the Zoo. Every day for him is a new challenge, because he gets a special task that he cannot do if he does not learn something about daily activities at the zoo _ diet, cleaning and decoration of dwelling, playing, training or treatment of animals. In this episode, Marko was tasked with making a dairy snake dwelling. Before moving on to the task, it should be found to be adapted to the premises of the animals to adapt their needs. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju,treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U ovoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti nastambu za mliječnu zmiju. Prije nego što krene na zadatak, treba doznati kako prostore u kojima borave životinje prilagoditi njihovim potrebama.

programme.title: Lou and a cheerful companion / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Damir accidentally upset Maks, when he doesn't explain exactly the rules of the game they play. / Damir slučajno uzruja Maksa, kad ne objasni točno pravila igre koju igraju.

programme.title: Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty -two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws with your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant the plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a lovely and tireless little six -year -old bitch of Australian cattle who lives with his mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves playing and draws all his family and the whole neighborhood into his world of fun and playing. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja.

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tvidi decides to paint the perfect Muc's picture, but Muc does not want to cooperate. Can the tweed adapt your perfect portrait to your imperfect and unpredictable pet? / Tvidi odluči naslikati savršenu Mucovu sliku, ali Muc ne želi surađivati. Može li Tvidi prilagoditi svoj savršen portret svome nesavršenom i nepredvidivom ljubimcu?

programme.title: Hu hu / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 extensions. In the series, we follow the adventures of a merry society in which Sovica is hu hu, the hedgehog of the Bocko and Zec Dusko. / Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.desc: Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 extensions. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: OGGY OGGY is a computer animated series for the preschool age of the author Jean Cayrol and Cedrica Gunerry, the series follows a kitten Ogya who embarks on an adventure with friends of Mallow and Sporty into the world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Number Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines which number they carry. The series helps young children easier to learn to count and solve simple mathematical tasks. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Praščić

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that foists the vitalness of childhood. In age, when small bunnies (like small children) are studying in people and experience challenges in relation to their parents, they move to school, learn generally about the world, they face authorities and, of course, learn their language. Children can take Simon for an example of taking care of himself, I can learn from him and from his incompetents, from situations where simon needs to give in in his insistence and spoiling, and always remain polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on books Stephanie Blake in the edition of the French publisher Lecole des loisirs. He was directed by the TV series Julien Cayot, and it was produced by Go-N Productions. The series in France had Prime Minister 17. December 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 numerals / 123 Brojčići

programme.title: Eko zona
programme.desc: Work is underway to revitalize the arboretum of brick in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin. After the renovation of the brick castle, built in the Baroque style back in the 2nd half of the 17th century, which decades for decades, a sediment from a small artificial lake was taken out and planned to plant indigenous and rare species. The introductory conference was recently held on the occasion of this project. Jaskovo is a small settlement within the City of Ozalj in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records back in 1433. It is in this ancient region that the economy of the Kovac family is located, which has a high -planned Scottish cattle in open pastures in free cultivation. In addition to cattle, the family grows in an eco -friendly pumpkin, nuts and hazelnuts. We also bring foreign news. A pearl series of islands and islets called the Hell Islands is a protected nature monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. In his bays and straits and today the meadows of Posidonia are still growing. / U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Nakon obnove dvorca Opeka, izgrađenog u baroknom stilu još u 2. polovici 17. stoljeća koji je desetljećima propadao, izvađen je sediment iz malenog umjetnog jezera te se planira sadnja autohtonih i rijetkih vrsta. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. Biserni niz otoka i otočića nazvan Pakleni otoci zaštićeni je spomenik prirode u kategoriji značajnog krajolika još od 1968. godine.
