programme.title: GP Confidential 2025 Magazine
programme.desc: Explore the sporting secrets of F1. Across 25 episodes and in crisp 3D animations, we analyses the technical details, which decide which teams make the most of the rules - and which need to go back to the drawing board. Complemented by features on historical milestones as well as race previews - GP Confidential is the perfect treat for any F1 fan.

programme.title: Race 1 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: The Misano weekend opens with a sprint that rewards clean starts, tyre warm-up and bravery through Curvone. Expect late dives into Turn 1, heavy braking at Quercia and traction duels out of Tramonto onto the back straight. Safety cars and track-limits calls can flip the order, while newcomers hunt points and title hopefuls set the tone for the round.

programme.title: Race 2 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: Race 2 reshuffles the deck after overnight tweaks. Warmer track temps raise tyre-degradation stakes, making slipstream timing on the main straight vital. Inside lines at Turn 1 and measured exits from Tramonto decide most passes. Watch for undercuts on out-laps, safety-car restarts, and penalties for track limits as contenders bank crucial mid-round points.

programme.title: Race 3 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: With setups refined, Race 3 is often the weekend’s fiercest sprint. Nose-to-tail packs form into Turn 1, while rhythm and patience through the fast right-lefts keep front tyres alive. Curvone commitment and a tidy run to Quercia create overtaking chances. Expect bold moves, defensive elbows, and strategy on push laps to climb

programme.title: Race 4 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: The Misano finale. Championship hopefuls chase maximum points as fatigue, tyre life and track limits shape the last attacks. A strong launch, disciplined braking at Quercia and perfect traction from Tramonto decide podiums. Anticipate safety-car drama, photo-finish drafts to the stripe, and decisive moves under pressure as the round closes with a flat-out sprint.

programme.title: Race 5 - Formula 4 Italy - Misano Round - 2025
programme.desc: Rising talents go wheel-to-wheel at Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli in Race 5. Slipstreams on the main straight and commitment through Curvone shape the order, while track limits, safety cars, and bold restarts can flip everything late. A flat-out sprint where newcomers and title hopefuls fight to the flag.

programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

programme.title: My Faith in Sport - Sawm
programme.desc: Ramadan is a crucial period in the Islamic calendar but fasting (Sawm) can provide complications for athletes who are trying to compete at the highest level. But to what extent is fasting a negative or can it actually aid performance? We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. Experts in Sports Science and Nutrition from Aspetar Clinic, Qatar also add detail of the physical impact athletes encounter during Ramadan.

programme.desc: ATP 250 European Open 2025 (10th edition) debuts in Brussels after nine years in Antwerp, staged on indoor-hard courts at Brussels Expo (Palais 12), 13–19 Oct. Expect fast, first-strike tennis, sharp returns and tie-break pressure as contenders fight for late-season ranking points and momentum toward Turin.

programme.title: Boks: Aaron McKenna - Mickey Ellison
programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. Ne propustite svaku priliku da uživate u ovom uzbudljivom sportu.

programme.title: Sport - MMA: EFN 13 Rakic ​​VS Manuwa / Borilački sport - MMA: EFN 13 Rakic vs Manuwa
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. programme.title: Beauty UFC 318 / MMA UFC 318
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Atlanta Falcons - Buffalo Bills / Američki fudbal - NFL: Atlanta Falcons - Buffalo Bills
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - French League: Paris - Monaco / Košarka - Francuska liga: Paris - Monaco
programme.desc: The competition of the highest rank of club basketball in France is called LNB Pro A. League was founded in 1921. that changed its name throughout history. In the league, 18 teams competes in the regular season, play each other each matches. After 34 cars played eight of the best teams enters the play off and fight for the title of France champions. The team with the most won titles is the asvel. / Takmičenje najvišeg ranga klupske košarke u Francuskoj naziva se LNB Pro A. Liga je osnovana 1921. godine koja je kroz istoriju više puta menjala svoj naziv. U ligi se takmiči 18 ekipa koje u regularnom delu sezone međusobno odigraju po dve utakmice. Nakon 34 odigrana kola osam najboljih ekipa ulazi u plej of i borbu za titulu prvaka Francuske. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je ASVEL.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Red Star - Zalgiris / Košarka - Euroleague: Crvena zvezda - Zalgiris
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: American Football - NFL: Atlanta Falcons - Buffalo Bills / Američki fudbal - NFL: Atlanta Falcons - Buffalo Bills
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Wurzburg - Igokea / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Wurzburg - Igokea
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba Basketball Champions League. The aim of this league to compete with the Organization of Euroleague Basketball S.L. And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The system of competition consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the end tournament of the best four or popularly called Fajbal for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: CSKA - Pari nn / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - Pari NN
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.desc: Through the long history of the football match, the representation always had a special charm in players and fans, whether it was official or friendly matches. programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Benfica - Spartak / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Benfica - Spartak
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is a new Fiba Basketball Champions League. The aim of this league to compete with the Organization of Euroleague Basketball S.L. And her Euroleague that includes the strongest European clubs. In this league clubs, they acquire the right to perform on the basis of placements in their own national championships while in the Euroleague of the rights, it is acquired on the basis of licenses. The system of competition consists of two rounds of qualifications, regular part, playoffs and the end tournament of the best four or popularly called Fajbal for. The finish is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: FBBAL - League of Europe: Feyenoord - Aston Villa / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Feyenoord - Aston Villa

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Barcelona - Valencia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Manisa - Erokspor / Košarka - Turska liga: Manisa - Erokspor
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. programme.title: Basketball - Italian League: Cantu - Reggio Emilia / Košarka - Italijanska liga: Cantu - Reggio Emilia
programme.desc: The long history of Italian lega Basket Serie and dates back to the back of 1920. And her insight. The first winner was the basuary of the basket of the same 1920. years. Only the competition consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents two-circle, followed by a plejof of eight teams. programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Bayern - Bamberg / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Bayern - Bamberg
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The competition consists of 18 teams, and the season is divided into the regular part where everyone plays with each two-circuit and the Plejof section that steps after completing the regular part. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. The interestingness of the league is that each team must have a hall of a minimum of 3000 places for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Bayern - Milano / Košarka - Euroleague: Bayern - Milano
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Sarajevo - Zrinjski
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Borac - Dubai / Košarka - ABA liga: Borac - Dubai
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.desc: Charles moves to Kansas with his wife and daughters. The lush Indian landscape already likes him. They quickly settle with their wife and three daughters. Basketball (M): Future - Trento, Eurocup 2025, Group B / Košarka (M): Budućnost - Trento, Eurocup 2025, Skupina B
programme.desc: The Euro was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. This competition is fighting the strongest basketball clubs that have failed to qualify for the Euroleague, mostly involved in the Top 15 most powerful European leagues. Clubs are provided by national championships and trophies and through invitations, i.e. "Wildcards". / Evrokup je nastal leta 2002 kot drugo tekmovanje "Evrolige Basketball". V tem tekmovanju se borijo najmočnejši košarkarski klubi, ki se niso uspeli uvrstiti v Evroligo, v njem pa večinoma sodelujejo klubi iz top 15 najmočnejših evropskih lig. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Nogomet (m): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Slovenia - Switzerland, World Cup qualifiers 2026 / Nogomet (M): Slovenija - Švica, Kvalifikacije za Svetovno prvenstvo 2026
programme.desc: Switzerland read a real lesson a month ago by the Slovenian national football team, will be anything different in Stožice? More than two hundred members of the International Football Organization (FIFA) competes in the qualifiers for the main World Cup tournament. However, it is common for everyone to be an overture to the final tournament. The qualification is still increasing the fact that no one but the host has the right to participate in the final tournament, and the world champions have to compete for the opportunity to defend the title. / Švica je pred mesecem dni slovenski nogometni reprezentanci odčitala pravo lekcijo, bo v Stožicah kaj drugače?Več kot dvesto članic Mednarodne nogometne organizacije (FIFA) tekmuje v kvalifikacijah za glavni turnir svetovnega prvenstva v nogometu.Dolge in zelo napete kvalifikacije se razlikujejo glede na to, za katero kontinentalno konfederacijo gre. Vsem pa je skupno to, da gre za uverturo v končni turnir.Pomen kvalifikacij še povečuje dejstvo, da na zaključnem turnirju nima pravice sodelovati nihče razen gostitelja, svetovni prvaki pa se morajo izboriti za priložnost za obrambo naslova.

programme.title: Košarka (M): CeDevita - ARIS, Eurocup 2025, Group a / Košarka (M): Cedevita - Aris, Eurocup 2025, Skupina A
programme.desc: The Euro was created in 2002 as the second "Euroleague Basketball" competition. This competition is fighting the strongest basketball clubs that have failed to qualify for the Euroleague, mostly involved in the Top 15 most powerful European leagues. Clubs are provided by national championships and trophies and through invitations, i.e. "Wildcards". / Evrokup je nastal leta 2002 kot drugo tekmovanje "Evrolige Basketball". V tem tekmovanju se borijo najmočnejši košarkarski klubi, ki se niso uspeli uvrstiti v Evroligo, v njem pa večinoma sodelujejo klubi iz top 15 najmočnejših evropskih lig. Uvrstitev v Evrokup si klubi zagotovijo preko nacionalnih prvenstev in pokalov ter preko povabil, t.i. "wildcards".

programme.title: Handball (Ž): Gyor - FTC, Hungarian League / Rokomet (Ž): Gyor - FTC, Madžarska liga
programme.desc: The first women's handball league in Hungary is the most important competition of women's handball in this country. It takes place in the organization of the Hungarian Handball League, and its beginnings date back to 1951. In the beginning, only four teams competed in the league, and over time this number has expanded to twelve teams, which are twice struggling in the season, on home soil and away. / Prva ženska rokometna liga na Madžarskem je najpomembnejše tekmovanje ženskega rokometa v tej državi. Odvija se v organizaciji Madžarske rokometne lige, njeni začetki pa segajo v leto 1951. V začetku so v ligi tekmovale le štiri ekipe, skozi čas pa se je to število razširilo na dvanajst ekip, ki se v sezoni spopadejo dvakrat, na domačih tleh in v gosteh.

programme.title: Masera, village under Matajur, documentary, Mon. / Mašera, vas pod Matajurjem, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: Just below Matajur, considered the Holy Mountain of the Venetian Slovenes, we visited the village of Masera, where the host, Luisa Battistig took us through the history of the village. In three museum collections, we can learn about the history of life in the village once. In the first, the objects that the locals used daily are exhibited. In blacksmithing we can see the blacksmith's tool left behind by Michele, Miha Dus. In the adjacent house, however, today he is stirred by the imagination of visitors "Uelbana Kljet", a vaulted cellar and a stone table in the middle of it. / Tik pod Matajurjem, ki velja za sveto goro Beneških Slovencev, smo obiskali vas Mašera, kjer nas je domačinka, Luisa Battistig popeljala skozi zgodovino vasi. V treh muzejskih zbirkah lahko spoznamo zgodovino življenja v vasi nekoč. V prvi so razstavljeni predmeti, ki so jih domačini uporabljali vsak dan. V kovačiji si lahko ogledamo kovaško orodje, ki ga je pustil za seboj zadnji kovač Michele, Miha Dus. V sosednji hiši pa še danes buri domišljijo obiskovalcev »uelbana kljet«, obokana klet in kamnita miza, ki stoji sredi nje.

The testimonies of actors, their colleagues and contemporaries, combined with archival recordings and other relics, unveil the strategies and tactics of Laibach and Laibach Kunst in the first half of 1980, their vision, wit, the breakthrough of the Iron Curtain and the occupation of Europe and reach through the monumental myths of the group. The red thread, however, is all the time plates or pieces from it: the emici, force, in the middle of the fighting, the state, the decree, we are making the future, my brother and panorama, which are the foundation of Laibach oeuvre. / LP film prikazuje prelomne trenutke prve petletke »inženirjev človeških duš«. programme.title: S-Prehodi: dr. Salvator Žitko, Mon. / S-prehodi: dr. Salvator Žitko, pon.
programme.desc: In today's show we will discuss the topic of cultural heritage as a subject of national prestige and Istrian identity. This is also the subtitle of the new scientific monograph by the authors of Salvator Žitko and Brigitte Mader, the book novelties of the Annales publishing house. According to the author, this territory means not only the extreme southeastern boundaries of the Central European cultural space, but the Mediterranean and northern cultures come here. The linguistic, cultural and economic succession of the Venetian Republic is still manifested in the urban image, art and dialect rumor of Istrian coastal towns. The intersection of different cultures is also revealed by finds that testify to ancient, rich contacts and exchanges. / V današnji oddaji bomo obravnavali temo kulturne dediščine kot predmet nacionalnega prestiža in istrske identitete. To je tudi podnaslov nove znanstvene monografije avtorjev Salvatorja Žitka in Brigitte Mader, knjižne novosti založbe Annales. Kot poudarjata avtorja, to ozemlje ne pomeni samo skrajne jugovzhodne meje srednjeevropskega kulturnega prostora, ampak se tukaj stikata sredozemska in severna kultura. Jezikovno, kulturno in gospodarsko nasledstvo Beneške republike se še danes kaže v urbani podobi, umetnosti in narečni govorici istrskih obalnih mest. Stičišče različnih kultur razkrivajo tudi najdbe, ki pričajo o davnih, bogatih stikih in izmenjavah.

programme.title: Osmi and, pound. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: We visited the days of the silent film in Pordenon, one of the greatest and most important festivals, where there are mute films with live musical accompaniment. We watched both classics and film rarities from archives and a cinema from all over the world, and a central retrospective entitled Chaplin-Mania studied the influence of Charlie Chaplin, his role models and numerous imitators. This year, Andrej Goričar, author of the score for the movie Our Hospitaly Buster Keaton, appeared there. With the live performance of his music, created specifically for this event, this year's festival also concluded. We watched the first three parts of the new family sequel such is the life that was created in the feature program of our television. We talked to the creators, among other things, the challenges in the implementation of such extensive production, which covers as many as 48 half -hour episodes, the creation of the script, the design of the characters and the intertwining of topics intended for all generations. We also checked what our audiovisual culture is and how the audience accepts innovations on our screens. Ljubljana was visited by Goran Markovic, Serbian director, writer and a sharp critic of social events in Serbia. In the extensive oeuvre of an extremely productive author (signed under about 50 documentaries and 13 feature films), we find insightful descriptions of social events in literature. His novel Doctor D. was recently released in Slovenian translation. The everyday Belgrade and the social, urban and political aspects of urban life are explored by the Belgrade Raw photographic collective. When asked how to attract attention at all, he responds with a raw, untreated photo of the banality of everyday life. At the Photon Gallery, we watched his exhibition entitled The more I watch, the more silly it is. / Obiskali smo Dneve nemega filma v Pordenonu, enega največjih in najpomembnejših festivalov, kjer so v središču nemi filmi z živo glasbeno spremljavo. Ogledali smo si tako klasike kot filmske raritete iz arhivov in kinotek z vsega sveta, osrednja retrospektiva z naslovom Chaplin-mania pa je preučevala vpliv Charlieja Chaplina, njegove vzornike ter številne imitatorje. Letos je tam ponovno nastopil Andrej Goričar, avtor partiture za film Our hospitality Busterja Keatona. Z živo izvedbo njegove glasbe, ustvarjene posebej za to prireditev, se je letošnji festival tudi sklenil. Ogledali smo si prve tri dele nove družinske nadaljevanke Takšno je življenje, ki je nastala v igranem programu naše televizije. Z ustvarjalci smo se med drugim pogovarjali o izzivih pri uresničitvi tako obsežne produkcije, ki zajema kar 48 polurnih epizod, o nastajanju scenarija, zasnovi likov ter prepletu tem, ki so namenjene vsem generacijam. Preverili smo tudi, kakšna je naša avdiovizualna kultura ter kako občinstvo sprejema novosti na naših ekranih. Ljubljano je obiskal Goran Marković, srbski režiser, pisatelj ter oster kritik družbenega dogajanja v Srbiji. V obsežnem opusu izredno produktivnega avtorja (podpisuje se pod okoli 50 dokumentarcev in 13 celovečernih igranih filmov) najdemo pronicljive opise družbenega dogajanja tudi v literaturi. Njegov roman Doktor D. je pred kratkim izšel v slovenskem prevodu. Vsakdanji Beograd in socialne, urbane in politične vidike mestnega življenja pa raziskuje fotografski kolektiv Belgrade Raw. Na vprašanje, kako v poplavi podob sploh pritegniti pozornost, odgovarja s surovo, neobdelano fotografijo banalnosti vsakdana. V Galeriji Photon smo si ogledali njegovo razstavo z naslovom Bolj ko gledam, bolj neumno je.

Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: The spirits on the facades returns to architecture as aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially since it offers natural chemicals without chemicals while creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in the Gorenjska region, farmers used to burn wooden buildings intentionally to protect them from weather and pests. Architects followed the materiality of riparian objects in this part of Slovenia at the renovation of the boatmill on the western edge of Lake Bled. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2000 varieties of plants from around the world. It extends on a half -hectaric hectare of carefully entrenched terrain, where you will find an instructive walk between magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. Razprostira se na poldrugem hektarju skrbno utrjenega strmega terena, kjer vas čaka poučen sprehod med veličastnimi drevesi in grmovnicami ter osupljiv razgled na okoliške hribe.

programme.title: Trail millennium: Heritage of the Regional Museum in Ljubljana, Documentary Film, Mon. / Sled tisočletij: Dediščina Deželnega muzeja v Ljubljani, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Amir Muratović ... The National Museum of Slovenia is the oldest continuous functioning museum institution in Slovenia. He has saved almost 100,000 years of history in 200 years. / R: Amir Muratović... Narodni muzej Slovenije je najstarejša neprekinjeno delujoča muzejska ustanova na Slovenskem. V 200 letih je shranil skoraj 100.000 let zgodovine.
programme.desc: Throughout the history and present of the museum, visitors will be directed by the Jubilee Exhibition of the Golden Trail. The film is accompanied by the preparation of the concept of the layout, the concern of restorers and conservators for objects, setting up an exhibition and its final image. At the time of the founding of the provincial museum, they turned to patriotic friends of science. The first collections were donated to the museum by Counts Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, Mayor of Hradecki and Bishop Wolf and Baraga. The first exhibition spaces in the lyceum were too small and the construction of the new museum building was undertaking. In honor of the wedding of Crown Prince Rudolf, it was named Rudolfinum. The plans and interior equipment were attended by local artists and masters, authors of the paintings in the entrance hall and on the staircase are Janez and Yuri Subic. At all periods, the leadership of the museum was aware that it was a national museum that preserves the heritage of millennia. The First Museum later split into several institutions. First, the ethnographic museum became independent, then the Museum of Natural History, which still has premises in the same building today, and after the second war, the present archive of the Republic of Slovenia also took place. The National Gallery received many artworks from the National Museum. Film highlights the most important museums, such as a non -English whistle, pile -site finds, jewelry of the princes of Stika, Situla from Vač, Mummy, Statue of Emonca, Roman sword from Ljubljanica, first photographs on glass, Prešeren's legacy. The authors were interested in the stories of objects, what they used, why they were important and, above all, whether they were placed through new museum insights at a time than when the museum acquired them. In this way, the film also features a valuable scientific work of curators, restorers and all others who take care of the preservation and protection of museum objects. The filmmaker and director of the film is Amir Muratović, director of photography and cameraman Bernard Perme, editor Zlatjan Čučkov, author and music performer Boštjan Gombač. / Skozi zgodovino in sedanjost muzeja bo obiskovalce vodila jubilejna razstava Zlata sled. Film spremlja pripravljanje koncepta postavitve, skrb restavratorjev in konservatorjev za predmete, postavljanje razstave in njeno končno podobo. Ob ustanovitvi takratnega Deželnega muzeja so se obrnili na domoljubne prijatelje znanosti. Prve zbirke so muzeju podarili grofje Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, župan Hradecki ter škofa Wolf in Baraga. Prvi razstavni prostori v liceju so bili premajhni in lotili so se gradnje nove muzejske stavbe. V čast poroke prestolonaslednika Rudolfa so jo poimenovali Rudolfinum. Pri načrtih in notranji opremi so sodelovali domači umetniki in mojstri, avtorja poslikav v vhodni dvorani in na stopnišču sta Janez in Jurij Šubic. Vodstva muzeja so se v vseh obdobjih zavedala, da gre za nacionalni muzej, ki ohranja dediščino tisočletij.Prvotni muzej se je pozneje razdelil na več institucij. Najprej se je osamosvojil Etnografski muzej, nato Prirodoslovni muzej, ki ima še danes prostore v isti stavbi, po drugi vojni pa se je izdvojil še današnji Arhiv Republike Slovenije. Narodna galerija je veliko umetnin dobila iz Narodnega muzeja.Film izpostavlja najpomembnejše muzealije, kot so neandertalska piščal, koliščarske najdbe, nakit stiške kneginje, situla iz Vač, mumija, kip Emonca, rimski meči iz Ljubljanice, prve fotografije na steklu, Prešernova zapuščina. Avtorja so zanimale zgodbe predmetov, čemu so služili, zakaj so pomembni in predvsem, ali so skozi nova muzealska spoznanja umeščeni v času drugače, kot takrat, ko jih je muzej pridobil. Na ta način je v filmu predstavljeno tudi dragoceno znanstveno delo kustosov, restavratorjev in vseh drugih, ki skrbijo za ohranitev in varovanje muzejskih predmetov.Scenarist in režiser filma je Amir Muratović, direktor fotografije in snemalec Bernard Perme, montažer Zlatjan Čučkov, avtor in izvajalec glasbe Boštjan Gombač.

programme.desc: A group of Dantics Companys Outittites, after twenty-five years, meet at the funeral dun dells. The Institute's time made them a heterogeneous, gamber and full of life group, but life was distributed very diverse to TV3 on the table, after the end of the creek, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday it runs in Barcelona and the protagonists live throughout the geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Labyrinth of Shadows), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even fun. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Treaty by her boyfriend, Teresa Sen goes from village and flees to the big city. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: Friendly: Spain - Bulgaria / Amistoso: España - Bulgaria
programme.desc: The Spanish team will play its last match of 2002 against Bulgaria. It is a friendly match that will be held at the Nuevos Cármenes stadium in Granada. Iñaki Sáez's pupils will not play again until February 12, the date on which they will face Germany. / La seleccion española disputará ante Bulgaria su último encuentro del año 2002. Se trata de un partido amistoso que se celebrará en el estadio Nuevos Cármenes de Granada. Los pupilos de Iñaki Sáez no volverán a jugar hasta el proximo 12 de febrero, fecha en la que se enfrentarán a Alemania.

programme.title: Under-21 Euro Cup Qualification (T25/26): Spain - Finland / Clasificacion Eurocopa sub-21 (T25/26): España - Finlandia
programme.desc: 51 teams divided into nine groups are fighting to get into the U-21 Euro Cup that will be held in Albania and Serbia in 2027. Among them, Spain, which shares a league with Romania, Finland, Kosovo, Cyprus and San Marino. / 51 selecciones repartidas en nueve grupos pelean por meterse en la Eurocopa sub-21 que se disputará en Albania y Serbia en 2027. Entre ellas, España, que comparte liguilla con Rumanía, Finlandia, Kosovo, Chipre y San Marino.

programme.title: Superbike World Championship - EstorilCarrera 1 / Mundial de Superbike - EstorilCarrera 1
programme.desc: The Superbike World Championship is a large displacement motorcycle competition parallel to the World Speed ​​Championship. The 2025 calendar consists of twelve tests. Three scoring races are held in each event. Toprak Razgatlioglu defends title. / El campeonato del mundo de Superbike es una competicion de motos de gran cilindrada paralela al mundial de velocidad. El calendario de 2025 consta de doce pruebas. En cada evento se disputan tres carreras puntuables. Toprak Razgatlioglu defiende título.

programme.title: Superbike World Championship - EstorilCarrera 2 / Mundial de Superbike - EstorilCarrera 2
programme.desc: The Superbike World Championship is a large displacement motorcycle competition parallel to the World Speed ​​Championship. The 2025 calendar consists of twelve tests. programme.title: Supersport World Cup - EstorilCarrera 2 / Mundial de Supersport - EstorilCarrera 2
programme.desc: The Supersport World Championship is a motorcycle competition that shares its calendar and circuits with the Superbike World Championship. Throughout the year, 12 grand prix are held, starting in February at Phillip Island and ending in October. / El campeonato del mundo de Supersport es una competicion motociclista que comparte su calendario y los circuitos con el Mundial de Superbike. A lo largo del año, se realizan 12 grandes premios, comenzando en febrero en Phillip Island y terminando en octubre.

programme.desc: Program with all the information regarding the qualification matches for the 2026 World Cup. / Programa con toda la informacion referente a los partidos de clasificacion para el Mundial de fútbol de 2026.

programme.title: Triathlon European CupTenerife - Esprín M / Copa de Europa de triatlonTenerife - Esprín M
programme.desc: The European Triathlon Cup is a competition that has been held annually since 1984. It is a series of races that take place in several countries in Europe, where athletes compete in swimming, cycling and running events. / La Copa de Europa de Triatlon es una competicion que se celebra anualmente desde 1984. Se trata de una serie de carreras que se llevan a cabo en varios países de Europa, donde los atletas compiten en pruebas de natacion, ciclismo y carrera a pie.

programme.title: UCI Pro Seriesparís - Tours / UCI Pro SeriesParís - Tours
programme.desc: The classic one-day test that links the French towns of Paris and Tours reaches its 119th edition this year. The route, very flat except for some climbs in the final part, is suitable for sprinters. In 2024, Christophe Laporte won. / La clásica prueba de un día que une las localidades francesas de París y Tours llega este año a su 119ª edicion. El recorrido, muy llano a excepcion de algunas subidas en la parte final, es propicio para los esprínteres. En 2024, se impuso Christophe Laporte.

programme.title: Milla Internacional de Berango
programme.desc: The Berango International Mile reaches its 37th edition. This athletic event held annually in the Basque town is one of the important events on the urban middle distance calendar. / La Milla Internacional de Berango llega a su 37ª edicion. Esta prueba atletica que se celebra anualmente en la localidad vasca es una de las citas importantes en el calendario del medio fondo urbano.

programme.title: Handball Honor Division (F) (T25/26): Morvedre - Mahay Handball / Division de Honor de balonmano (F) (T25/26): Morvedre - Balonmano Mahay
programme.desc: The 14 best women's handball teams compete in the Division of Honor. Bera Bera, current champion of the competition, is the rival to beat. Málaga, La Calzada or Remudas are emerging as the main alternatives. / Los 14 mejores equipos femeninos de balonmano disputan la Division de Honor. El Bera Bera, actual campeon de la competicion, es el rival a batir. Málaga, La Calzada o Remudas se perfilan como las principales alternativas.

programme.title: TDP Reports - Winter SportsSnowboard - Queralt Castellet / Reportajes TDP - Deportes de inviernoSnowboard - Queralt Castellet
programme.desc: TDP's reports aim to promote Spanish sport. An approach to athletes and less followed competitions that serve to value the effort and sacrifice of the participants. / Los reportajes de TDP pretenden promocionar el deporte español. Una aproximacion a los atletas y a las competiciones de menor seguimiento que sirven para poner en valor el esfuerzo y el sacrificio de los participantes.

programme.title: Futsal First Division (F) (T25/26): Guadalcacín - Atletico Navalcarnero / Primera Division de fútbol sala (F) (T25/26): Guadalcacín - Atletico Navalcarnero
programme.desc: Sixteen teams make up the Primera Iberdrola de Fútbol Futsal, the highest women's competition in the country. After 30 days of regular league play, the four best teams fight in the playoffs for the title. Navalcarnero's Futsi defends crown. / Dieciseis equipos componen la Primera Iberdrola de Fútbol Sala, la máxima competicion femenina del país. Tras 30 jornadas de liga regular, los cuatro mejores equipos pelean en las eliminatorias por el título. El Futsi de Navalcarnero defiende corona.

programme.title: ASOBAL (T25/26): Granollers - Barcelona
programme.desc: ASOBAL, the Spanish professional handball league, has been dominated with an iron fist by Barcelona for years. The Barça team is the top favorite, in what would be its sixteenth consecutive title. The rest of the teams intend to fight back. / La ASOBAL, la liga de balonmano profesional española, lleva años dominada con mano de hierro por el Barcelona. El conjunto azulgrana es el máximo favorito, en el que sería su decimosexto título consecutivo. El resto de equipos pretenden plantar cara.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: The disputed gold of Gorla by Marco Tagliabue An important precious metals refinery, MKS PAMP, and the hardship of the neighborhood that hosts it: Gorla, a small hamlet of Castel San Pietro. A story that, between protests and discussions, has continued for forty years, animating two generations of citizens. The fumes that come out of the company's chimneys and the smells that sometimes invade the neighborhood have become the symbol of a difficult coexistence. Behind those fumes accumulate doubts, protests, silences and requests that often go unanswered. Meanwhile, a recent question in the Grand Council rekindles the case and calls for solutions. The Falò investigation recounts the fears of the residents, reports the timely responses of the company managers and documents the air controls carried out by the Canton. Antwerp, the refinery of discord by Mattia Pacella and Simon BrazzolaThe Value Trading gold refinery in Antwerp, Belgium, definitively ceased operations in 2024 after years of controversy. Located in the city, in the Jewish quarter, it was accused by residents of causing serious health problems. The Belgian Ministry of the Environment ultimately refused to renew the environmental license despite the absence of clear scientific evidence. The Falò reportage reconstructs the citizens' battle, the experts' assessments and the reactions of politicians. The dust of Cama by Gianluca Monnier In Cama, in Val Mesolcina, a group of inhabitants protests against a waste disposal and recycling center located close to the Moesa river. For some time, neighboring citizens have been bothered by the dust and loud noises that come from the recycling center that has been active for decades. In addition to complaints, neighboring residents also raise questions about the company's location and its compliance with the current planning zone. A long-standing and complex situation to which the municipal and cantonal authorities respond. / L’oro conteso di Gorla di Marco Tagliabue Un’importante raffineria di metalli preziosi, la MKS PAMP, e il disagio del quartiere che la ospita: Gorla, piccola frazione di Castel San Pietro. Una vicenda che, tra proteste e discussioni, si protrae da quarant’anni, animando due generazioni di cittadini. I fumi che escono dai camini dell’azienda e gli odori che a tratti invadono il quartiere, sono diventati il simbolo di una convivenza difficile. Dietro a quei fumi si accumulano dubbi, proteste, silenzi e richieste che spesso non trovano riscontro. Intanto, una recente interrogazione in Gran Consiglio riaccende il caso e chiede soluzioni. L’inchiesta di Falò racconta i timori dei residenti, riferisce le puntuali risposte dei manager dell’azienda e documenta i controlli sull’aria effettuati dal Cantone. Anversa, la raffineria della discordia di Mattia Pacella e Simon BrazzolaLa raffineria d’oro Value Trading di Anversa in Belgio nel 2024 ha cessato definitivamente l’attività dopo anni di polemiche. Situata in città, nel quartiere ebraico, veniva accusata dai residenti di causare gravi problemi sanitari. Il ministero dell’ambiente belga ha infine rifiutato di rinnovare la licenza ambientale nonostante l’assenza di prove scientifiche univoche. Il reportage di Falò ricostruisce la battaglia dei cittadini, le valutazioni degli esperti e le reazioni della politica.Le polveri di Cama di Gianluca MonnierA Cama, in Val Mesolcina, un gruppo di abitanti protesta contro un Centro di smaltimento e riciclaggio dei rifiuti che sorge a ridosso del fiume Moesa. Da diverso tempo i cittadini confinanti sono infastiditi dalle polveri e dai rumori molesti che provengono dal Centro di riciclaggio attivo da decenni. Oltre alle lamentele, i vicini residenti sollevano anche domande sull’ubicazione dell’azienda e la sua conformità con l’attuale zona di pianificazione. Una situazione annosa e complessa alla quale rispondono le autorità comunali e cantonali.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: Fumes, odors and unpleasant noises are the symbol of a difficult coexistence between the PAMP refinery in Castel S. Pietro and the inhabitants of the Gorla district. Falò reportage among the citizens' concerns, the timely responses of the company managers, the feedback from the Municipality and the Canton. / Fumi, odori e rumori sgradevoli sono il simbolo di una convivenza difficile tra la raffineria PAMP di Castel S. Pietro e gli abitanti del quartiere di Gorla. La vicenda si protrae da anni e continua a suscitare lamentele, dubbi e richieste di soluzioni. Una recente interrogazione in Gran Consiglio riaccende il caso e chiede dintervenire. programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.desc: To continue playing with her sister, Marine pushes Wendy's love interest to boomerang with Dad. No matter, Marine orchestrates a recovery of the lover... against her sister's promise to spend half the afternoon with her. / Pour continuer à jouer avec sa sister, Marine pousse le namoureux de Wendy à faire du boomerang avec Papa. Mais Wendy n’est pas prete à laisser son père accaparer son Maxou, et le plan de Marine lui revient en boomerang : Wendy se met elle aussi au boomerang et ne veut plus jouer avec sa sister. Qu’à cela ne tienne, Marine orchestre une recuperation du namoureux… contre la promesse de sa sister de passer la moitie de l’aprèm avec elle.

programme.title: Les Sisters
programme.sub-title: One Sister too many / Une Sister de trop
programme.desc: Marine has invited Nath for a pajama party: Wendy can't take any more of this fuss and is screaming! Since her big Sister is evil, Marine decides to make Nath her nice new Sister. But when, during the evening, Nath begins to admire Wendy and her adult activities, Marine is no longer so happy with her new sister... / Marine a invite Nath pour une pyjama party : Wendy n’en peut plus de tout ce raffut et hurle ! Mais quand, au cours de la soiree, Nath se prend d’admiration pour Wendy et ses activites de grande, Marine n’est plus si contente de sa nouvelle sister …

programme.title: Les Sisters
programme.desc: The parents go out for the evening and Auntie Coco looks after the Sisters. While Wendy and Maxence listen to the latest Vandalize album, Marine and Coco play on the console. And the meeting with the mysterious member of the Court who must give it to him takes place that same evening! But Aramis recognizes in the Shadow his father, former fencing master of the Cadet school. How will she admit to him that she has given up the sword? / D’Artagnan, Aramis et Alex rencontrent l’Ombre, un agent secret au service de Louis XIII. Selon lui, Ademar de l’Adandur va obtenir une arme redoutable. Et le rendez-vous avec le mysterieux membre de la Cour qui doit la lui remettre a lieu le soir-meme ! Mais Aramis reconnaît en l’Ombre son père, ancien maître d’armes de l’ecole des Cadets. Comment va-t-elle lui avouer qu’elle a renonce à l’epee ?

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: As they return by carriage to Paris, Louis XIII and Charlotte are attacked by bandits. Ce dernier le nomme Mousquetaire dans sa garde personnelle, au grand desarroi de Monsieur de Treville et de Charlotte, que Jussac ne c...

programme.sub-title: The roi leon / Le roi Leon
programme.desc: Lord Buckingham has been kidnapped! And with it, the gift from the King of England to Louis XIII! All this because of Milady who, to fix things, tries to conclude a marriage with the Duke, by pretending to be a poor young woman, oppressed by her sister! Athos and Aramis rush to Buckingham's rescue, while dArtagnan and Porthos come face to face with the lost “gift”. / Lord Buckingham a ete enleve ! Et avec lui, le cadeau du roi dAngleterre à Louis XIII ! Tout cela à cause de Milady qui, pour arranger les choses, tente de conclure un mariage avec le Duc, en se faisant passer pour une pauvre jeune femme, opprimee par sa sœur ! Athos et Aramis foncent à la rescousse de Buckingham, tandis que dArtagnan et Porthos se retrouvent nez-à-bec avec le « cadeau » perdu.

programme.desc: The night April breaks up with Patrick, a married man, the two have an accident. programme.sub-title: A Christmas legend / Une legende de Noël
programme.desc: At the end of a theatrical performance of The Little Match Girl, Santa Claus is murdered and the presents have disappeared. Le detective Murdoch, le docteur Ogden, linspecteur Brackenreid et le detective Crabtree devront elucider cette affaire et decouvrir le meurtrier du Père Noël de Toronto.

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: A mysterious attacker kills two members of the Princes of Thunder, a biker gang, in their mechanic workshop. At the crime scene, Jane discovers a cache of assault rifles and Korsak thinks it is a settling of scores between arms traffickers. One of the bikers has a trace of lipstick and a local resident says he saw a woman fleeing the workshop: could she have been a witness to the tragedy? The DNA of Kelly Wagner, close to bikers, is found in the lipstick sample. Frankie and Nina call on her but she refuses to cooperate. On parole, she returns to prison where, upon her arrival, she seeks to recruit a killer. Jane is then incarcerated to try to discover the identity of her target, who could be the author of the murder of the bikers... / Un mysterieux agresseur abat deux membres des Princes du Tonnerre, un gang de bikers, dans leur atelier de mecanique. Sur les lieux du crime, Jane decouvre une cache de fusils dassaut et Korsak pense quil sagit dun règlement de compte entre trafiquants darmes. Lun des bikers porte une trace de rouge à lèvres et un riverain dit avoir vu une femme senfuir de latelier : aurait-elle ete temoin du drame ? LADN de Kelly Wagner, une proche des bikers, est retrouve dans lechantillon de rouge à lèvre. Frankie et Nina linterpellent mais elle refuse de cooperer. En liberte conditionnelle, elle retourne donc en prison où, dès son arrivee, elle cherche à recruter un tueur. Jane se fait alors incarcerer pour essayer de decouvrir lidentite de sa cible, qui pourrait etre lauteur du meurtre des bikers...

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: The trial of Banyon, an alleged burglar and murderer, has just begun. Jane is expected to testify at the hearing. But the main piece of evidence was stolen from the seals room. Investigators have 65 hours to find new evidence, so that the accused is not released. They are in fact totally convinced of his guilt. They are trying to find out who may have stolen these crucial pieces, but doubt they will be able to recover them in time. Furthermore, Frankie decides to learn some magic tricks in order to impress Nina... / Le procès de Banyon, un cambrioleur et assassin presume, vient de souvrir. Jane est censee temoigner lors de laudience. Mais la principale pièce à conviction a ete volee dans la pièce des scelles. Les enqueteurs ont 65 heures pour trouver de nouvelles preuves, afin que le prevenu ne soit pas libere. Ils sont en effet totalement convaincus de sa culpabilite. Ils cherchent à decouvrir qui a pu derober ces pièces cruciales, mais doutent de pouvoir les recuperer à temps. Par ailleurs, Frankie decide dapprendre quelques tours de magie afin dimpressionner Nina...

programme.title: A bon entendeur
programme.sub-title: Change your decor like your shirt? / Changer de deco comme de chemise ?
programme.desc: “Fast deco” brands like HandM Home, Zara Home or Søstrene Grene have been flourishing in our city centers for several years. Their objective: to encourage us to constantly renew our interiors, to the rhythm of trends or the seasons. But behind these fashionable and inexpensive vases, candlesticks and baskets, what is the real cost of this decorative frenzy? “À bon entendeur” takes you behind the scenes of this booming market in Switzerland, where the decor is inspired by the codes of fast fashion to seduce us. Between temptation, pleasure and ecological impact, should we really succumb to fast decor? Decoding of this phenomenon in “À bon entendeur”, Tuesday at 8:10 p.m. on RTS1! / Les enseignes de «fast deco» comme HandM Home, Zara Home ou Søstrene Grene fleurissent depuis quelques annees dans nos centres-villes. Leur objectif: nous inciter à renouveler sans cesse nos interieurs, au rythme des tendances ou des saisons. Mais derrière ces vases, bougeoirs et paniers à la mode et à petits prix, quel est le vrai coût de cette frenesie decorative? «À bon entendeur» vous emmène dans les coulisses de ce marche en plein boom en Suisse, où la deco s’inspire des codes de la fast fashion pour nous seduire. Entre tentation, plaisir et impact ecologique, faut-il vraiment succomber à la fast deco? Decodage de ce phenomène dans «À bon entendeur», mardi à 20h10 sur RTS1 !

programme.title: Enquete en famille
programme.desc: Charline's investigation begins with the tragic discovery of a woman shot dead on her horse in the middle of the forest. Bastien va quant à lui devoir se racheter auprès de Charline...

programme.title: Enquete en famille
programme.desc: An employee discovers the lifeless body of Christophe Piatek, a salesman from Nantes, in his hotel room. He was suffocated with his pillow. programme.title: New York Unite Speciale

programme.desc: Millie is a creative, resourceful and clever 8-year-old girl. With her friends Maya and Ben, and her dog Wallace, she forms a small team always ready to take on the challenges of her neighborhood. Build a pirate ship, a mini-library or a birdhouse... Millie is full of imagination to improve the daily lives of her neighbors. / Millie est une fillette de 8 ans creative, debrouillarde et astucieuse. Avec ses amis Maya et Ben, et son chien Wallace, elle forme une petite equipe toujours prompte à relever les defis de son quartier. Construire un bateau pirate, une mini-bibliothèque ou une cabane à oiseaux… Millie deborde d’imagination pour ameliorer le quotidien de ses voisins.

programme.title: Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: Tyrone struggles to draw a squirrel for an art project. The Creators Club then decides to form the squirrel brigade to help Tyrone. / Tyrone a du mal à dessiner un ecureuil pour un projet dart. Le Club des createurs decide alors de former la brigade des ecureuils afin daider Tyrone.

programme.title: Millie la Magnifique
programme.desc: It's time for a badminton tournament in Millie's garden. When she can't get to her badminton rackets because of a spider's web, she and her friends realize they can make their own rackets with paper plates, rope and a sparrow ball. / Il est temps pour un tournoi de badminton dans le jardin de Millie. Quand elle ne peut se rendre à ses raquettes de badminton à cause d’une toile d’araignee, ses amis et elle se rendent compte qu’ils peuvent faire leurs propres raquettes avec des assiettes en papier, de la corde et un ballon comme moineau.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.sub-title: No, no, no and no / Non, non, non et non
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs help mom look after Sally, the little neighbor who is just learning to talk. Maddie would like Sally to have a good time, but whatever she offers her - toys, a snack or games - Sally responds every time: "No!" Could it be that she answers no to all the questions asked of her? / Maddie et Triggs aident maman à garder Sally, la petite voisine qui apprend tout juste à parler. Maddie voudrait que Sally passe un bon moment, mais quoi quelle lui propose - des jouets, un goûter ou des jeux - Sally lui repond à chaque fois : "Non !" Se pourrait-il quelle reponde non à toutes les questions qui lui sont posees ?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs are bored. It has been raining for hours, even though they had planned to play outside. After exhausting ideas for activities to do indoors, they notice that in the midst of the silence, the house is making sounds that they have never noticed before. Once miniaturized, they go in search of these new sound treasures, which for some, are due to work that mom and dad have not yet been able to do, like repairing the leaking faucet. But this adventure will keep them busy until the rain stops. / Maddie et Triggs sennuient. Il pleut depuis des heures, alors quils avaient prevu de jouer à lexterieur. Après avoir epuise les idees dactivites à faire en interieur, ils saperçoivent quau milieu du silence, la maison fait des sons quils navaient encore jamais remarques. Une fois miniaturises, ils partent à la recherche de ces nouveaux tresors sonores, qui pour certains, sont dûs à des travaux que maman et papa nont pas encore pu faire, comme reparer le robinet qui fuit. Mais cette aventure va les occuper jusquà ce que la pluie sarrete.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It's bath time in Charivari, but Triggs can't find his toy: Denis the duck. Maddie and Triggs embark on a bubble-filled underwater adventure to the bottom of the ocean, but can Captain Maddie and Lieutenant Triggs save Denis the Duck before it's too late? / Cest lheure du bain à Charivari, mais Triggs ne trouve pas son jouet : Denis le canard. Maddie et Triggs se lancent dans une aventure sous-marine pleine de bulles jusquau fond de locean, mais la capitaine Maddie et le lieutenant Triggs parviendront-ils à sauver Denis le canard avant quil ne soit trop tard ?

programme.desc: Moomin, a curious and idealistic hero, lives in the heart of the magical land of Moomin Valley, surrounded by his family and extraordinary friends. À travers son parcours initiatique, on en apprend plus sur notre propre humanite.

programme.title: La vallee des Moomins
programme.desc: When the Mumla arrives unannounced at the Moomin house with all her unruly children, the famous tolerance of the Moomin family is put to the test. But it's especially hard for Moomin the troll, who finds himself confronted with Little Mu, a true force of nature... / Lorsque la Mumla arrive sans prevenir à la maison Moomin avec tous ses enfants turbulents, la celèbre tolerance de la famille Moomin est mise à rude epreuve. programme.desc: One evening, the farmer sits down to watch a movie with fried chicken. Outside, a tired Shaun has accidentally filled his empty pillowcase with a live chicken. programme.title: Shaun le mouton
programme.desc: When Farmer Ben delivers his perfect Christmas card, Shaun and the gang secretly knit sweaters to try to make the Mossy Bottom Farm card even more spectacular. programme.title: Top models

programme.desc: If the matter seems resolved, for Ariane, something is wrong. Jennifer, for her part, does everything she can to make herself look good, even if it means overdoing it. Vous allez pouvoir suivre le quotidien de plusieurs familles et habitants de cette ville, où se melent des histoires d’amour et d’amitie mais aussi des mensonges, des trahisons ou encore de lourds secrets de famille… Retrouvez tous les comediens de votre saga quotidienne avec Ingrid Chauvin, Anne Caillon, Alexandre Brasseur...

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles
programme.sub-title: For better and for worse / Pour le meilleur et pour le pire
programme.desc: A man was found shot to death in a park. According to initial findings, his murderer hid in the bushes while waiting for him and used a hunting rifle to execute him. The victim does not have her cell phone on her but according to her signal, it is about a hundred meters away, in the park. As Jane and Korsak go there, they find the object next to what they think is a second corpse. But although unconscious, this man is alive. And Jane's surprise is when she finds a photo of him and Maura as newlyweds in his wallet. After examining his clothes, Kent found not only blood belonging to the victim but also gunshot residue. Would the one Maura refers to as her ex-husband be a witness or guilty?... / Un homme a ete retrouve abattu dans un parc. Daprès les premières constatations, son meurtrier sest cache dans les buissons en lattendant et sest servi dun fusil de chasse pour lexecuter. La victime na pas son telephone portable sur elle mais daprès son signal, il est à une centaine de mètres de là, dans le parc. Alors que Jane et Korsak se rendent sur place, ils retrouvent lobjet à côte de ce quils pensent etre un second cadavre. Mais bien quinconscient, cet homme est vivant. Et quelle nest pas la surprise de Jane quand elle trouve dans son portefeuille une photo de lui et Maura en jeunes maries. Après examen de ses vetements, Kent y relève non seulement du sang appartenant à la victime mais aussi des residus de tir. Celui que Maura designe comme son ex-mari serait-il temoin ou coupable ?...
